topic_desc_basic: The Forecaster is a young orphaned boy living beneath the 188 Trading Post overpass. Travelers passing through know he offers "forecasts"—insights into the past and future—in exchange for caps. He wears a strange headpiece he calls his "medicine" to manage headaches from using his abilities. He surrounds himself with collected wasteland items like books and flags.
tags: 188 trading post,cathedral psyker connection,mojave wasteland,orphaned psychic child,psychic nullifier

topic_desc: Thomas Hildern was educated by the Followers of the Apocalypse but broke with them over what he characterized as their adherence to "old-world dogma," preferring to pursue large-scale practical results. He helped form the Office of Science and Industry (OSI), an organization focused on finding practical applications for knowledge. As the ambitious director of the OSI eastern division at Camp McCarran, he openly disapproves of the direction taken by executives at OSI Central and aspires to rise to a role in the central office within a few years by demonstrating his branch's effectiveness. Despite his supervisory position, Hildern performs no actual research himself; colleague Angela Williams accuses him of taking credit for others' work. He has recently focused on the NCR's projected food shortage—production is estimated to fall short of population needs within a decade due to expansion. He identified Vault 22, a pre-war facility dedicated to agricultural research, as a potential breakthrough. Rather than seeking NCR authorization, he hires mercenaries directly, a practice Williams warns is dangerous; many hired field workers have never returned, including a scientist named Keely, whom Hildern believed had a personal interest in undermining him.
topic_desc_basic: Thomas Hildern is the director of the NCR Office of Science and Industry's eastern division, based at Camp McCarran. His office oversees Hoover Dam power optimization and food production research, including the NCR Sharecropper Farms. He was originally trained by the Followers of the Apocalypse before helping establish OSI.
tags: camp mccarran,followers of apocalypse,ncr food shortage,osi eastern division,vault 22 research

topic_desc: Ulysses was a member of the Twisted Hairs, an Arizona tribe whose distinctive knotted hairstyle communicated messages based on their medicinal knowledge. After Caesar betrayed the tribe and dispatched Vulpes Inculta to enslave and murder them at Dry Wells, Ulysses continued serving the Legion as a scout and Frumentarius, using his medical knowledge to cure companions. He later lived in Hopeville, a settlement in the Divide, until underground nuclear missiles were detonated by a package the Courier delivered, destroying the area. Ulysses survived and blamed the Courier for the loss. He traveled to Big MT, where he cared for an injured Brotherhood of Steel Knight named Royce and encountered the Think Tank, who explained how the Divide's missiles were activated. On Caesar's orders, he led the White Legs against New Canaan to kill Joshua Graham, teaching them to use weapons from excavated bunkers. Despite these events, he still describes Legion members as his brothers, "even as misguided as they are." He was one of seven couriers hired by Mr. House to carry packages to the New Vegas Strip but turned down the job, leading the Courier to carry the Platinum Chip. He lured the Courier back to the Divide via graffiti near Canyon Wreckage and a radio signal, leaving decals throughout the Divide and Big MT—red marking hostile areas, white marking the way forward, and blue denoting hidden caches. He named himself after Ulysses S. Grant. He is one of only three characters in the Mojave with 10 points in all SPECIAL attributes.
tags: caesar legion frumentarii,lonesome road courier,the divide hopeville,twisted hairs tribe,white legs new canaan

topic_desc: Veronica's personal history is deeply intertwined with the Mojave Brotherhood's decline. She traveled west as a child under Father Elijah's command, originally bound for Hoover Dam before Elijah diverted the expedition to occupy HELIOS One. Her parents—a paladin and a scribe—both died fighting the NCR, leaving Elijah as her guardian. She describes him as a "wizard with technology" and credits him with nurturing her technical aptitude. Her former partner Christine Royce left the Brotherhood, defying procreation expectations, while Veronica stayed behind, unable to abandon her community despite recognizing its stagnation. She openly clashed with Elder McNamara's permanent lockdown, arguing the Brotherhood's original mission of controlling technology had devolved into purposeless isolation. She frequently visits the 188 Trading Post to scavenge and observe how other Mojave groups adapt, seeking solutions the Brotherhood refuses to pursue.
topic_desc_basic: A young woman in Brotherhood of Steel power armor is sometimes seen trading and scavenging at the 188 Trading Post. Mojave wastelanders know the Brotherhood as a secretive, isolationist group that hoards old technology, but few know much about individual members or their internal affairs.
tags: 188 trading post,brotherhood isolationism critic,brotherhood of steel scribe,christine royce relationship,father elijah mentor,helios one battle,hidden valley bunker,mojave brotherhood decline

topic_desc: Yes Man represents Benny's ambitious scheme to seize Mr. House's technological empire. Originally a standard PDQ-88b securitron, he was disabled by a pulse grenade and recovered by Benny's Chairmen. Followers of the Apocalypse member Emily Ortal reprogrammed him in exchange for access to Mr. House's secrets, creating an AI incapable of refusing orders or withholding information from anyone. Yes Man mined House's databases, discovering the platinum chip's delivery routes, which enabled Benny to ambush the Courier at Goodsprings Cemetery. After Benny's downfall, Yes Man transfers his allegiance to the Courier, offering full control over the Strip's securitron network. His plan involves upgrading securitrons to Mk II status via the platinum chip, securing the El Dorado Substation's power, and ultimately expelling both the NCR and Legion from the Mojave. Following the Hoover Dam battle, Yes Man discovers code fragments in House's mainframe that make him "a little more assertive," addressing concerns about his unconditional compliance.
tags: benny usurpation plot,emily ortal reprogramming,independent new vegas,lucky 38 mainframe,mr house replacement,platinum chip courier,reprogrammed securitron ai,securitron mk ii

topic_desc: Vault 8 served as one of Vault-Tec's control vaults, functioning without any experimental parameters. Two years after the Great War, its doors opened and residents used a Garden of Eden Creation Kit to establish Vault City. The vault's three levels include medical facilities staffed by Doctor Troy, storage areas containing spare water chips originally intended for Vault 13, and a command center with the overseer's chamber and water processing computer. The vault's nuclear reactor governs Vault City's capacity for expansion. By the time of the Chosen One's visit, Vault City had developed into a segregated settlement with strict citizenship requirements, reflecting the vault dwellers' isolationist tendencies and technological superiority over surrounding wasteland communities.
topic_desc_basic: Vault 8 is a control vault whose inhabitants used a Garden of Eden Creation Kit to establish Vault City in the Core Region. The vault remains the heart of the settlement, housing medical facilities and a nuclear reactor that powers the city and governs its capacity for expansion.
tags: geck usage,nuclear reactor power,spare water chips,vault 8 control vault,vault city settlement

topic_desc: Construction of Vault 92 began in May 2062 and completed in 2068, designed for 245 occupants. Overseer Richard Rubin implemented Vault-Tec's White Noise Mind Suggestion Combat Experimentation after sealing on October 23, 2077. Professor John Malleus assisted with the technical implementation, initially unaware that Rubin had extended white noise emitters beyond recording studios into living quarters. The experiments induced trance-like states with near-100% suggestion effectiveness, but caused progressive neurological damage leading to psychosis. Within months, over 30% of the population went insane, resulting in approximately 35 deaths. Malleus eventually discovered Rubin's deception and attempted to confront him. The vault also suffered structural deterioration from nearby underground water sources, eventually flooding after maintenance crews perished.
topic_desc_basic: Vault 92 sits in the ruins northwest of Old Olney, a dangerous area most wastelanders avoid. Before the War, Vault-Tec supposedly recruited musicians to preserve humanity's musical heritage there. Like other vaults, it has long since fallen silent, and scavengers who venture near report it is flooded and largely inaccessible.
tags: capital wasteland vault,combat suggestion experiment,musical talent vault,richard rubin overseer,vault 92 white noise

topic_desc: Vault 106's experiment involved releasing psychoactive drugs into the air filtration system ten days after sealing, with the Overseer fully aware that residents would become test subjects. Security personnel were ordered to dismiss concerns about unusual odors as filtration irregularities. The drugs caused persistent hallucinations, with affected residents eventually becoming violent Insane Survivors clad in Vault 106 jumpsuits. By 2277, the drugs remain active in the air system, producing blue-tinted hallucinations in anyone entering. Survivors attempted to escape by blowing through the vault walls, evidenced by skeletons and a Mini Nuke in a cave area. The vault contains a Science Bobblehead and various skill books among its ruined corridors.
topic_desc_basic: Vault 106 is a ruined Vault-Tec vault in the Capital Wasteland, southeast of Arefu. Wastelanders know it as a dangerous place inhabited by insane survivors. Rumors persist that something in the air system drives people mad, causing hallucinations and violence.
tags: air filtration drugs,capital wasteland vault,hallucination experiment,insane survivors,vault 106 psychoactive drugs

topic_desc: Construction of Vault 108 began in March 2061 and was cut short in December 2069. Designed for 475 residents over 38 years, the vault's experiment deliberately left most positions unassigned for the Overseer to fill. The primary power supply was engineered to fail after 20 years, with an insufficient backup geo-thermal system. Overseer Brody Jones was chosen specifically because medical tests indicated a rare cancer would kill him within three years, creating a leadership crisis. The vault was stocked with triple the normal defensive weaponry and lacked entertainment facilities. Scientists conducted extensive cloning experiments on a subject named Gary, producing at least 54 clones. Each successive clone exhibited increasing hostility toward non-clones, with Gary 54 injuring staff. By the time of the Lone Wanderer's arrival, only hostile Gary clones and creatures remained.
topic_desc_basic: Vault 108 is a ruined Vault-Tec vault in the Capital Wasteland, south of Canterbury Commons. Scavengers know it as a dangerous ruin filled with hostile clones of a man named Gary, who attack any outsider on sight.
tags: brody jones overseer,capital wasteland vault,gary clones,power failure experiment,vault 108 cloning experiment

topic_desc: Vault-Tec Corporation operated under the government's classified Project Safehouse, protected by the New Amended Espionage Act. The multi-billion dollar corporation acquired laboratories, bought out competitors, and established headquarters in Los Angeles and Washington, D.C. Vault-Tec University in Morgantown trained its top executives and scientists. The company constructed over 100 vaults, some built in secret with numbers omitted from public records. While a small contingent of control vaults functioned as advertised, the majority featured unique experimental scenarios designed to test occupants under specific circumstances. The Enclave was involved in the planning stages, describing the program as "a social experiment on a grand scale." Vault-Tec equipment was often faulty—water chips were prone to failure, and shipping errors sometimes switched water chips and GECK deliveries. The company authorized its private security to use lethal force during admission protocols. Vault-Tec promoted its shelters through billboards, newspaper advertisements, corporate PR events, and a large exposition at the Museum of Technology in Washington, D.C. Employees received the Vault-Tec Employee Handbook, which governed all procedures down to bathroom break time limits.
topic_desc_basic: Vault-Tec was a major pre-War corporation that built the underground vaults scattered across the former United States. Before the bombs fell, the company aggressively marketed vaults as shelters to protect ordinary citizens from nuclear war, using its cheerful Vault Boy mascot in advertisements and public events. Most wastelanders recognize the distinctive blue-and-yellow vault doors and jumpsuits.
tags: pre-war defense contractor,project safehouse,social experiment program,vault construction,vault-tec corporation

topic_desc: The vault experiments were conceived during the planning stages of vault construction, with the Enclave describing the program as "a social experiment on a grand scale" using "a unique set of circumstances designed to test the occupants." Experimental scenarios varied widely: some vaults lacked sufficient food synthesizers, some housed only men, and others were designed to open after only six months. Scientists at Hawthorne Medical Laboratories, a Vault-Tec division, attempted to create hybrid humans in Vault 4 using radioactive resistant species. Not all vaults were completed before the Great War, and some sealed without their intended inhabitants. Others were constructed in secret, their numbers omitted from public record. The 17 control vaults were designed to function properly, preserving segments of society for reasons known only to the secretive elements behind the project. According to rumors, these elements sought to cause or hasten the Great War to see their vision realized. Vault life varied dramatically depending on whether residents occupied a control vault or an experimental one. Inhabitants were required to sign numerous forms before entry, including liability waivers, organ donation invoices, and rights revocation charters. Vault-Tec provided all clothing, bedding, and accommodations, and personal belongings were subject to review by authorized hermetics technicians.
topic_desc_basic: Before the Great War, Vault-Tec built over a hundred underground vaults across the United States and Canada to shelter citizens from nuclear war. Most wastelanders know these vaults existed, though many never opened as advertised and some were never completed.
tags: control vaults,enclave social experiment,societal preservation program,vault experiments,vault-tec testing

topic_desc: The G.E.C.K. was designed to ease the process of harnessing the post-nuclear wasteland for vault dwellers emerging from their shelters. Developed by Stanislaus Braun, the kit represented Vault-Tec's vision for post-War reconstruction. The matter-energy replicators within the kit were advertised as capable of creating food and basic items needed for building new environments. The inclusion of atmospheric chemical stabilizers and water purifiers suggests the device was intended to render contaminated surroundings habitable. The reading material—drawn from the Library of Congress and encyclopedic sources—was provided to give survivors access to accumulated human knowledge. Shipping errors during vault preparation sometimes resulted in G.E.C.K. deliveries being switched with water chips, meaning some vaults never received their intended kits. The G.E.C.K. was a critical resource for any vault dweller community intending to rebuild on the surface, combining terraforming technology with survival essentials in a single portable case. Its creation by Future-Tec, a Vault-Tec division, reflects the parent corporation's involvement in both shelter construction and post-War planning, though the extent to which vault dwellers were informed of the kit's existence varied.
topic_desc_basic: The Garden of Eden Creation Kit, or G.E.C.K., was a Vault-Tec device advertised before the War as a tool for rebuilding civilization. It was reportedly packed into a briefcase and included seeds, soil supplements, a power generator, and water purifiers. Whether any surviving kits still exist is unknown.
tags: future-tec division,geck terraforming device,post-war reconstruction,stanislaus braun invention,vault-tec technology

topic_desc: The United States government began the Pan-Immunity Virion Project in 2073 to counteract biological weapons, aiming to alter DNA so it would resist viral infection. By March 2075, the virion was renamed FEV, and Major Barnett ordered experiments focused on the virus's quad-helix structure, which granted subjects immunity to infection and radiation beyond expectations. Testing progressed through flatworms, insects, mice, dogs, and chimpanzees, with abnormal growth rates and increased brain activity noted in all subjects. In January 2077, research transferred to the Mariposa Military Base for human trials. When the security team discovered the inhumane nature of the work, Roger Maxson took charge, interrogated and executed scientists, and abandoned the base—an act that founded the Brotherhood of Steel. Post-War, Richard Grey fell into FEV vats at Mariposa and mutated into the Master, who sought radiation-free humans to transform into super mutants using FEV-2. The Enclave isolated the virus's most toxic elements to create FEV Curling-13, a lethal agent targeting only humans. In the Capital Wasteland, the Enclave under President John Henry Eden developed a modified FEV intended to contaminate the water supply through Project Purity, which specifically targeted immune systems on a cellular level. Vault 87 also utilized modified FEV as part of its Evolutionary Experimentation Program, transforming inhabitants into super mutants.
tags: enclave biological weapon,fev mutation,forced evolutionary virus,super soldier project,west tek pathogen

topic_desc: The Pip-Boy 3000 was developed by RobCo Industries before the Great War as a personal information processor for Vault dwellers and military personnel. The 3000A variant, an older model within the A series, is commonly found strapped to the left forearm of wasteland inhabitants who have acquired them from Vault stocks or scavenged supplies. The device integrates a Geiger counter for radiation detection, a radio receiver capable of picking up wasteland broadcasts, and a display screen that can be pushed to over-bright mode, functioning as a 360-degree illumination source in darkened environments. Files can be transferred from compatible terminals directly to the Pip-Boy. The device is powered by a fission battery, as confirmed by Christine Royce of the Circle of Steel. Father Elijah, the former elder of the Brotherhood of Steel chapter at HELIOS One, demonstrated that the Pip-Boy 3000 can be hacked remotely, dismissing it as a piece of RobCo trash. A variant known as the Pimp-Boy 3 Billion exists, obtainable through dealings with Mick, an arms dealer operating in Freeside. Vault radio broadcasts remind dwellers that proper cleaning and maintenance will ensure the device's operation for future generations.
topic_desc_basic: The Pip-Boy 3000 is a pre-War RobCo Industries personal information processor worn on the left forearm. Common among vault dwellers and some wastelanders, it displays vital statistics, maps, and inventory, and includes a Geiger counter, radio, and a light function.
tags: fission battery powered,geiger counter radio,pimp-boy 3 billion,pip-boy 3000a model,robco personal processor,wrist-mounted device

topic_desc: The Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System, known as V.A.T.S., combines the Pip-Boy's sensors and computing power with automated combat analysis. Developed before the Great War, it identifies hostile targets, evaluates specific anatomical regions, and helps the wearer plan a sequence of precise attacks more quickly than unaided observation would allow. The resulting tactical assessment can draw attention to an exposed limb, a weapon-bearing arm, or another vulnerable area while reducing reliance on reflex alone. V.A.T.S. is integrated into the Pip-Boy interface rather than carried as a separate weapon, allowing information from the wearer's surroundings to feed directly into its targeting display. Its creation demonstrates that Vault-Tec's research extended beyond shelters into personal defense and military applications. The similarity between its acronym and the Mariposa FEV vats has encouraged speculation, but no proven technical connection between those programs is known.
topic_desc_basic: The Vault-Tec Assisted Targeting System, or V.A.T.S., is a combat aid built into Pip-Boy devices. It uses the wearable's sensors to scan nearby threats and lets the user target specific body parts for more precise attacks. Most wastelanders have never used one, as functioning Pip-Boys are rare outside vault communities.
tags: action point targeting,body part targeting,pre-war military technology,tactical assessment system,vault-tec combat system

topic_desc: The Stealth Boy was invented by Robert Mayflower and entered production through RobCo Industries as a wrist-mounted personal stealth device, designated the 3001 variant. The device functions by generating a modulating refraction field that transmits reflected light from one side of the wearer's body to the opposite side, effectively bending visible light around the user and rendering them almost invisible to the unaided eye. Some Stealth Boys were developed through reverse engineering of captured Chinese Stealth Armor technology. After the Great War, Doctor Henry conducted research into the Mark II variant, which was intended to reduce power consumption. However, the Mark II's modulating field produced unintended permanent neurochemical changes in users, including schizophrenia and other psychological conditions. These effects proved especially devastating among the Nightkin, a faction of super mutants who relied heavily on Stealth Boys for their operations. Chewed variants of the device have been found in locations such as Charleston Cave in the Mojave Wasteland, suggesting deterioration or misuse over time. The Enclave also pursued improvements, with scientists developing a Mark III variant using Chinese schematics, drastically lowering power consumption rates compared to the Mark II while abandoning the wrist-mounted form factor.
topic_desc_basic: The Stealth Boy is a wrist-mounted RobCo device that bends light around the wearer, rendering them nearly invisible for a limited time. These devices are prized by wastelanders and are known to be used extensively by super mutants, particularly the Nightkin.
tags: chinese stealth armor,doctor henry research,light refraction field,neurochemical side effects,nightkin schizophrenia,robco stealth device

topic_desc: The Vertibird represents a class of vertical-lift aircraft developed by the United States military in the years leading up to the Great War. These advanced rotorcraft function as both transport vehicles and gunships, distinguished by their fuel-powered engines and formidable offensive capabilities, which include Gatling lasers, miniguns, and missile launchers. The XVB02 prototype was the culmination of pre-War vertical flight research and was scheduled to enter full military service in 2085, though the nuclear exchange of 2077 disrupted this timeline. Despite the devastation of the Great War, Vertibird technology survived and has been maintained by certain post-War factions. The Enclave, descendants of pre-War government and military personnel, have utilized Vertibirds extensively for troop deployment, supply runs, and close air support operations. In the Capital Wasteland, Enclave Vertibirds have been observed conducting operations around 2277, deploying soldiers and engaging ground targets. In the Mojave Wasteland, Vertibird sightings have been reported around 2281, associated with Enclave remnants and their ongoing activities. The aircraft's durability and versatility have made it one of the most significant pieces of surviving pre-War military hardware, granting its operators a substantial tactical advantage over factions limited to ground transportation.
topic_desc_basic: The Vertibird is a pre-War military vertical-lift aircraft used for transport and gunship roles. Armed with heavy weaponry, these aircraft are rare in the post-War wasteland. The Enclave is known to operate them, making their presence a sign of significant military power.
tags: enclave air support,gatling laser gunship,pre-war military aircraft,vertical lift helicopter,xvb02 prototype

topic_desc: Project Purity was an ambitious attempt to build a large-scale water purifier capable of filtering radiation from the sealed-off Tidal Basin at the Jefferson Memorial. James and Catherine led a team of like-minded scientists, and Elder Owyn Lyons provided a permanent Brotherhood of Steel garrison with sentry guns to maintain a safe perimeter against super mutant attacks. The team found a purification method that worked but was horribly inefficient, and mounting losses strained relations with the Brotherhood. Catherine's death during childbirth on July 13, 2258 precipitated the project's collapse. James withdrew entirely, fleeing with his child to Vault 101, and Lyons pulled his troops out, leaving the scientists to fend for themselves. Madison Li and the survivors salvaged what they could and moved to Rivet City. Years later, James discovered references to the Garden of Eden Creation Kit in Vault 101 records and returned to restart the project. The Enclave under Colonel Autumn seized the memorial by force, demanding control of the facility. James sacrificed himself by flooding the control chamber with lethal radiation. Lyons' Brotherhood ultimately used Liberty Prime to break through Enclave defenses, and the purifier was activated. Elder Lyons ordered the water distributed free to all major settlements, though the Brotherhood struggled with funding and resources, forcing Scribe Bigsley to quietly sell water to sustain operations.
topic_desc_basic: Project Purity is a long-running scientific effort centered on the Jefferson Memorial and intended to provide clean water to the Capital Wasteland. Most residents know scientists and major factions have shown interest in it, but its current operational status, control, and internal systems are not reliable public knowledge.
tags: aqua pura distribution,brotherhood of steel garrison,capital wasteland water,enclave seizure,james and catherine,jefferson memorial purifier

topic_desc: Hoover Dam, sometimes called the Old World Wall, was one of the most substantial sources of electrical power in the pre-War American Southwest, protected by anti-aircraft weapons. When the Great War struck, Mr. House's networked mainframes and laser systems kept the dam in almost untouched condition alongside much of Las Vegas. The plant sat abandoned for nearly two centuries until the Followers of the Apocalypse noted its continued existence as early as 2170. In 2274, NCR scouts arrived during the Mojave Campaign, prompting Mr. House to act. The Mojave Brotherhood of Steel had planned to claim the dam but was sidetracked at HELIOS One. The Treaty of New Vegas gave the NCR ninety-five percent of the dam's output while preserving Vegas sovereignty. Within a year, NCR engineers had the dam running at fifty percent capacity. The head engineer, Mike Lawson, reported that six turbines once ran but only four still functioned. In 2277, the Legion under the Malpais Legate attempted to seize the dam but was defeated when Chief Hanlon orchestrated a tactical retreat through Boulder City, detonating pre-placed explosives to trap the Legion's elite forces. Colonel Cassandra Moore and General Lee Oliver subsequently fortified the dam with a significant military presence and civilian contractors to prepare for a second Legion assault.
topic_desc_basic: Hoover Dam is a massive pre-War hydroelectric dam on the Colorado River that still generates electricity for the Mojave. The NCR has occupied it since 2274 and supplies power to New Vegas and their own territories under a treaty agreement. The Legion tried to take it by force in 2277 but was defeated.
tags: colorado river dam,first battle of hoover,hydroelectric power output,ncr mojave campaign,treaty of new vegas,turbine capacity

topic_desc: ARCHIMEDES II was commissioned by Poseidon Energy, which maintained behind-closed-doors relations with elements of the United States military that would become the Enclave. The system is an orbital laser platform tied to the HELIOS One solar collection arrays in Nevada. It can be triggered by triangulating between a beacon at HELIOS One and a targeting device called Euclid's C-Finder, allowing the satellite to precisely mark a point on the ground for bombardment. Three laser beams converge on the target, followed by a massive blue laser from orbit. The Brotherhood of Steel under Elder Elijah occupied HELIOS One and discovered the ARCHIMEDES II secret, but in 2276 the NCR laid siege during Operation: Sunburst and expelled the Brotherhood, seizing the facility. Ignacio Rivas, a Follower of the Apocalypse embedded at HELIOS One, has actively kept the NCR ignorant of the weapon's true nature, believing some things are best left buried with the old world. The NCR hired an incompetent conman known as Fantastic to manage the power plant, and the internal security systems remain too dangerous for soldiers to penetrate fully, though it is likely only a matter of time before the Archimedes mainframe is reached.
tags: euclid c-finder targeting,helios one facility,ignacio rivas deception,operation sunburst,orbital laser satellite,poseidon energy weapon

topic_desc: The REPCONN Test Site sits in a large valley accessible through a single canyon west of Novac. Before the war, REPCONN was finalizing a merger with RobCo Industries when a waste spill occurred around the time RobCo representatives were to visit. Steve Reynolds, the Launch Facility Project Manager, was blamed by Senior Engineer Martin Neimeyer, who cited Reynolds' overworking and under-compensation of employees as the cause, while Reynolds blamed Neimeyer. The facility features a reinforced checkpoint, a roundabout with a Delta IX rocket statue, research laboratories at the top, an assembly hall where rockets were prepared, and a basement connecting to the launch dome. Post-war, the Bright Brotherhood ghouls took refuge in the research laboratories, intending to undertake what they call the Great Journey into space using the facility's rockets. Chris Haversam, a human who believes himself a ghoul, serves as their engineer. Nightkin led by Davison occupied the basement, searching for a shipment of Stealth Boys whose records indicate two shipments were received and returned to the manufacturer, with five units missing due to workplace misbehavior. Feral ghouls escaped containment and wandered toward Novac, alarming local residents. The Bright Brotherhood's outer defenses were insufficient to stop the nightkin, who punched through and left dead Brotherhood members in their wake.
topic_desc_basic: The REPCONN Test Site is a ruined pre-War rocket facility west of Novac. Locals know feral ghouls wander from the grounds, but who occupies the sealed interior and what remains inside are not public knowledge.
tags: bright brotherhood ghouls,jason bright great journey,nightkin stealth boy search,novac feral ghoul threat,repconn robco merger,rocket testing facility

topic_desc: Sierra Madre vending machines were created at Big MT's Y-0 Research Center and commissioned by Frederick Sinclair, who bankrupted himself funding the project after witnessing the technology at a World's Fair exhibit. Sinclair struck a deal with Big MT executives to use the Villa as a proving ground for experimental technologies. The machines were designed not merely as vending devices but as emergency dispensers capable of supplying food, chems, security equipment, and maintenance tools in the event of nuclear catastrophe. Certain supplies were restricted by dispenser codes issued only to trained professionals and doctors. To Sinclair, the machines represented self-sufficiency for the Sierra Madre. To his employees, however, the machines felt like a company store—they received a modest amount of chips with each paycheck and could barely afford anything, especially given Sinclair's ban on all other vending machines. The Great War and the Sierra Madre's isolation left these as the only known surviving examples of the underlying technology. Around 2281, Father Elijah, a rogue elder of the Brotherhood of Steel, recognized the machines' potential as unlimited sources of food, supplies, medical assistance, ammunition, and even currency. The machines use Sierra Madre chips as batteries, drawing on alloys and raw materials within the chips to assemble dispensed items. According to Dean Domino, similar vending technology was common before the war.
tags: big mt technology,father elijah interest,frederick sinclair invention,pre-war emergency dispensers,sierra madre chips,sierra madre vending machines

topic_desc: The Cloud is a concentrated toxic haze that blankets the Villa and much of the Sierra Madre complex. Exposure to the Cloud causes steady deterioration of health, and concentrated pockets deal severe damage to anyone who enters them. The Cloud is one of the defining hazards of the Sierra Madre, contributing to its reputation as a death trap. Dean Domino, a pre-War entertainer who survived in the Villa for over two centuries, developed techniques for navigating Cloud-concentrated areas with reduced harm, extending the window of safe exposure before damage begins and lessening the overall health impact. Even with such techniques, concentrated Cloud remains lethal after prolonged exposure. In exterior areas of the Villa, a passive low-level exposure affects anyone present continuously. The Cloud, along with the Sierra Madre's hologram defenses and vending machine technology, drew the attention of Father Elijah around 2281. The rogue Brotherhood elder saw the Cloud as a means to wipe the slate clean, envisioning a combination of Cloud, collars, holograms, and vending machines as tools capable of destroying and rebuilding nations.
topic_desc_basic: Stories circulate in the Mojave about a toxic reddish-brown haze said to blanket the legendary Sierra Madre and its surrounding Villa. Rumor holds that the Cloud slowly sickens and kills anyone exposed to it, with concentrated pockets being especially lethal. Few who venture toward the Sierra Madre are said to return.
tags: concentrated cloud pockets,dean domino survival,father elijah weapon,sierra madre environment,toxic cloud hazard,villa toxic haze

topic_desc: Holograms are a pre-War technology employed throughout the Sierra Madre as security, staff, and vendor projections. They are generated by emitters that can be destroyed or disabled to eliminate individual holograms, or accessed via terminals to reprogram patrol routes and functions. In the Villa, most holograms are non-hostile, though a hostile security hologram guards the Villa Clinic. Upon entering the Sierra Madre Casino, holograms serve as the primary threat, as their emitters are not accessible, forcing reliance on terminal rerouting to avoid them. When casino power is restored, hostile security holograms are replaced by non-hostile staff holograms, including floor managers, a cashier, a bartender, and a lobby greeter. In the Executive Suites, starlet security holograms can be reprogrammed via terminals to prevent hostility, though their emitters should be deactivated to prevent reset. A hologram of Dean Domino can be used to shut down security protocols in the Tampico Theater. Holograms also appear in the Sierra Madre Vault. Starlet security holograms possess the ability to open doors, unlike standard variants. The technology was also present at Big MT's Z-38 Lightwave Dynamics Research facility.
tags: big mt lightwave dynamics,casino staff holograms,hologram emitter technology,hologram patrol rerouting,security hologram projections,sierra madre holograms

topic_desc: Alien technology refers to the suite of advanced devices and systems encountered aboard Mothership Zeta, an extraterrestrial vessel of unknown origin. The aliens inhabiting the ship possess technologies far exceeding pre-War human capabilities, including long-term cryostasis chambers, energy-based weaponry such as disintegrators and atomizers, shock batons for melee engagement, teleportation systems, and holographic projections. Some aliens employ an Inertia Suppression Field that functions as a personal shield, significantly boosting their resistance to damage. Guardian Drones serve as support units in combat. The aliens themselves are hostile to any intruders and demonstrate organized resistance throughout the vessel. Alien workers also exist aboard the ship but lack combat capability and cannot access many of the force-field doors that separate sections of the vessel. A dead alien was once discovered far north of the Scrapyard in the Capital Wasteland, accompanied by an Alien Blaster, suggesting extraterrestrial presence on Earth predating any encounter with the mothership itself. The full extent of alien technology remains poorly understood, as the vessel's internal structure and systems are largely inaccessible without overcoming its hostile occupants.
tags: alien cryostasis technology,alien inertia suppression,alien technology,alien teleportation devices,extraterrestrial energy weapons,mothership zeta systems

topic_desc: Power armor represents a major pre-War military achievement produced by West Tek and the United States government. Constructed from a poly-laminate composite reinforced with ceramic castings, the suits shield the wearer from radiation and physical harm while granting enhanced strength through joint servos. An airtight suit allows for survival without water for extended periods. Developed at Fort Strong, the armor saw deployment in China and during the Battle of Anchorage. The Enclave later developed advanced variants using lightweight ceramic composites, bearing their insignia and rank indicators. Following the Great War, suits are found throughout the wastelands, though removing the joint servos eliminates the need for specialized training.
topic_desc_basic: Power armor is pre-War military technology that encases the wearer in a heavily armored suit with powered joints, granting great strength and protection from radiation and physical harm. Suits from before the war still turn up across the wastelands. The Brotherhood of Steel is the faction most commonly seen wearing it.
tags: enclave advanced variant,fort strong development,joint servo armor,poly-laminate composite,pre-war military armor,west tek product

topic_desc: The T-45 series was the first power armor variant utilized by the United States military in combat. Built by West Tek, it was deployed against the People's Liberation Army in Alaska during the Battle of Anchorage. The suit suffered from significant design flaws, including a dangerous defect in the chest plate welding that reportedly persisted in suits worn by the Brotherhood of Steel after the Great War. A former West Tek product manager acknowledged the flaws were serious, though the armor's appearance was considered impressive. One of its original designers, Harold Frost, later designed the Excavator power armor for the Garrahan Mining Company. Stripping out the joint servos removes the need for specialized training to operate the armor.
topic_desc_basic: Power armor is pre-War military technology that turns a soldier into a walking tank. The Brotherhood of Steel in the Capital Wasteland wears a common model recognizable by its bulky metal frame and helmet visor. Most wastelanders know these suits are rare, heavily protective, and associated with organized military forces.
tags: alaska battle armor,brotherhood post-war armor,chest plate defect,first power armor,t-45 series armor,west tek military contract

topic_desc: The T-51 power armor is regarded as the pinnacle of pre-War mechanized protection. Developed by West Tek and the United States government, it uses a poly-laminate composite with a back-mounted TX-28 MicroFusion Pack and a HiFlo hydraulic system. A ten-micron silver coating reflects laser and radiation emissions. Developed at Fort Strong, it saw service in China and at the Battle of Anchorage, where it required adaptation for the cold climate. The first production run was sent to China in 2076. The T-51 represented a significant advancement over the earlier T-45 series, which had suffered from notable design flaws. Following the Great War, T-51 suits remain prized military hardware throughout the wastelands.
topic_desc_basic: The T-51 is the most advanced suit of pre-War power armor, widely recognized across the wastelands. Its bulky, rounded silhouette with a silvered finish is a symbol of old-world military might. Suits are rare and highly prized by anyone strong or well-equipped enough to wear one.
tags: anchorage battle armor,fort strong development,pinnacle pre-war armor,silver coated armor,tx-28 microfusion pack,west tek composite

topic_desc: Remnants power armor represents a legacy of the Enclave's advanced power armor program. It provides the highest level of protection among all known power armor variants in the Mojave Wasteland. The suit features a built-in ventilation and cooling system, a practical improvement for extended operation in the desert climate. It is paired with a matching remnants power helmet. Unlike other variants bearing faction insignia, this armor carries no affiliation, meaning its appearance does not provoke hostility from any particular group. The design incorporates lightweight ceramic composites that offer superior protection compared to earlier pre-War models.
topic_desc_basic: Remnants power armor is a variant of advanced power armor based on the Enclave's designs. It provides exceptional protection, being the most protective power armor variant known in the Mojave Wasteland. The armor features a built-in ventilation and cooling system. It is not associated with any particular faction, meaning it does not provoke hostility from any group based on the wearer's appearance.
tags: ceramic composite armor,enclave advanced armor,faction neutral armor,mojave power armor,relic prospectors find,ventilation cooling system

topic_desc: The NCR Ranger Combat Armor represents the union of two ranger traditions. The body armor originates from pre-war police riot gear, while the trench coat draws from the heritage of the Desert Rangers, who merged with the NCR Rangers under the Ranger Unification Treaty of 2271. Veteran rangers who have proven themselves through extended service earn the right to wear this armor. It is manufactured within the NCR using adapted pre-war equipment. Its imposing appearance, featuring a dark coat, gas mask, and antenna, has become synonymous with NCR power in the Mojave. The Brotherhood of Steel treats wearers of this armor with hostility.
topic_desc_basic: The NCR Ranger Combat Armor, commonly called the Black armor, is worn by veteran rangers of the New California Republic. The armor combines pre-war police riot gear with the traditional trench coat of the Desert Rangers, who merged with the NCR Rangers following the Ranger Unification Treaty of 2271. It is among the most recognizable symbols of NCR military authority in the Mojave Wasteland.
tags: black armor,desert ranger coat,mojave military equipment,ncr military,ncr ranger armor,ranger unification treaty,riot armor,veteran ranger gear

topic_desc: This distinctive suit of desert-camouflage combat armor bears the service data of Staff Sergeant R.B. Vickers, including his rank, name, and blood type. The helmet records locations in Nanjing and Shanghai with tally marks, suggesting a pre-war tour of duty in China, and bears the scrawl "FORGIVE ME MAMA." Though the name implies a connection to the Desert Rangers, the moniker actually derives from its camouflage pattern. The survivalist Randall Clark later stored the armor in Zion Canyon. Its design influenced the creation of the NCR Ranger Combat Armor, leading to frequent confusion between the two.
topic_desc_basic: A distinctive suit of desert-camouflage combat armor with a gas mask and olive duster is said to be cached somewhere in Zion Canyon. Its design resembles the gear worn by NCR veteran rangers, though it carries no faction markings. Some NCR rangers recognize the resemblance to their own kit.
tags: desert camouflage,desert ranger armor,pre-war marine armor,r.b. vickers,randall clark,stone bones cave,survivalist gear,zion canyon

topic_desc: The Advanced Riot Gear represents an evolution of pre-war riot control equipment developed for the 11th Armored Cavalry Regiment. It is a sophisticated variant of the standard Riot Gear used by NCR officers in the Divide. The construction incorporates a specialized "Riot Response" system designed to improve survivability in hazardous environments. The helmet features an integrated low-light vision system that activates automatically in darkness, emitting a distinctive red visual signature. This design is part of a broader family of riot control armors that includes the Elite Riot Gear and Desert Ranger Combat Armor, all tracing their origins to pre-war law enforcement and military equipment.
topic_desc_basic: Riot gear is a type of pre-war law enforcement and military armor. Some NCR forces in the Divide are said to wear an improved version with a distinctive helmet that glows red in the dark.
tags: 11th armored cavalry,advanced riot gear,divide equipment,lonesome road,ncr riot control,night vision,pre-war riot armor,riot helmet

topic_desc: Chinese Stealth Armor represents a significant technological achievement of the Sino-American conflict. Developed by Chinese military scientists, the armor employs advanced light modulation technology to bend light around its wearer, rendering them virtually invisible. This stealth capability made it the signature equipment of the Crimson Dragoon troops and Black Ghost counterinsurgency squads during the Resource Wars. The underlying technology proved so valuable that American forces reverse-engineered captured armor to create portable Stealth Boy units. Components and fragments of the armor have been identified at the X-13 Research Facility in Big MT, suggesting ongoing research into the technology. The armor remains a highly sought-after piece of pre-war military equipment, combining personal protection with unparalleled concealment capabilities.
topic_desc_basic: Chinese stealth armor, or Hei Gui armor, was a pre-war Chinese military suit that could make its wearer nearly invisible. American forces reverse-engineered it to create Stealth Boy devices.
tags: black ghost,chinese stealth armor,crimson dragoon,hei gui armor,light modulation,pre-war chinese military,resource wars,stealth boy

topic_desc: Tesla armor protects the wearer by using three attraction-coil rods to absorb and disperse energy from laser and plasma fire. The distinctive rods make the suit easy to recognize and give it a specialized role against directed-energy weapons. Some versions are built from modified metal armor, combining the coil system with protection against conventional attacks. A notable Mojave example is the Gannon family suit, which belonged to Arcade Gannon's father and survived as both effective equipment and a personal relic of the Enclave remnants. Its history connects the armor to individuals who carried Enclave technology into later wasteland communities. While accounts sometimes exaggerate the coils as making a wearer nearly invulnerable, the suit's real importance lies in redirecting incoming energy and demonstrating the adaptation of pre-War electrical engineering to personal protection.
topic_desc_basic: Tesla armor is a distinctive suit fitted with three prominent coil rods designed to absorb and dispose of energy from laser and plasma weapons. It is rare and prized by anyone expecting to face directed-energy fire. Some versions are built from modified metal armor for added protection against conventional attacks.
tags: directed energy protection,enclave armor technology,energy dispersal system,gannon family armor,tesla attraction coils

topic_desc: Combat armor is a family of pre-War protective suits constructed from advanced defensive polymers, thermal-dissipative membranes, and concussive plates. The United States military fielded standard and winterized versions, while law enforcement utilized reinforced riot gear. Desert Ranger armor was associated with Marine service and later influenced veteran protectors in the Southwest. Civilian possession once required a special permit due to the equipment's military nature. Following the Great War, surviving suits and derivative designs spread among organized wasteland forces. NCR Rangers employ combat armor suited for harsh terrain patrols, while the Van Graffs favor black suits that reinforce their identity as energy-weapon merchants. The Brotherhood of Steel maintains improved versions fabricated with superior materials. Camouflaged models demonstrate that combat armor was adapted for specialized environments rather than serving as a single uniform design.
topic_desc_basic: Combat armor is a family of pre-War military and police body armor made from advanced polymers and plates. It is lighter and more flexible than power armor but offers strong protection. After the Great War, NCR Rangers, Brotherhood forces, mercenaries, and caravan guards all use variants of it across the wastelands.
tags: brotherhood armor design,defensive polymer armor,law enforcement riot gear,military combat armor,ncr ranger equipment,thermal dissipative membrane

topic_desc: Development of the M42 Fat Man began at Fort Strong in February 2076 to provide infantry with a portable tactical nuclear weapon. Early warheads were too heavy to achieve sufficient range for operator safety. Engineers considered a rail-driven launcher, but its power supply was too cumbersome, and live-fire failures killed two project members. The breakthrough came from adapting a spigot-mortar principle. A sub-charge inside the warhead propelled it from the launcher, providing useful range without a large external power pack or a revealing smoke trail. After one hundred test firings, the design was declared complete in September 2077. Launchers and compatible warheads were then shipped to selected United States military sites. The weapon's combination of portability and nuclear force made it effective against fortified positions, though extraordinarily dangerous to anyone nearby.
topic_desc_basic: The Fat Man is a devastating pre-War shoulder-fired weapon that launches miniature nuclear warheads. Most wastelanders have only heard stories about these launchers, which were designed to let a single soldier destroy fortified positions with a tactical nuclear blast.
tags: fort strong development,m42 fat man,mini nuke launcher,portable nuclear weapon,spigot mortar mechanism,tactical nuclear launcher

topic_desc: Mini nukes were developed as ammunition for the M42 Fat Man project at Fort Strong. Engineers spent over a year reducing a nuclear warhead to a size infantry could carry while ensuring enough range to protect the firing team. Simply reducing the charge failed to solve the launch problem, and rail technology proposals demanded an impractically large power supply. The final design placed a propelling sub-charge within the warhead, allowing the Fat Man to catapult it using a spigot-mortar arrangement. This eliminated the need for a conventional rocket motor and left no smoke trail pointing back to the operator. By September 2077, repeated testing produced a completed weapon-and-ammunition system. Mini nukes were distributed with M42 launchers, leaving stockpiles of compact tactical nuclear ordnance scattered among military facilities when the Great War began.
topic_desc_basic: Mini nukes are small nuclear warheads fired from Fat Man launchers. They were developed by the U.S. military just before the Great War and shipped to military units overseas.
tags: 2077 military shipment,fort strong project,m42 launcher ammunition,miniature nuclear warhead,spigot mortar warhead,tactical nuclear ordnance

topic_desc: The AER series of laser rifles were produced in small prototype runs by the United States Armed Forces, with the series reaching at least version twelve. The AER9 was considered the most dependable model, owing to its titanium-housed crystal array, which proved more robust than the components used in later variants. Laser rifles can be powered by battery packs, fusion cells, or microfusion cells. While their low recoil makes long-range combat require less marksmanship ability, field service presents challenges: water can clean and cool various parts, but broken lenses require great skill to fabricate or repair, and the Wave Particle Diverter is similarly difficult to manufacture. The Winchester P94 Plasma Rifle shares the same microfusion cell power supply as laser rifles. During the Sino-American War and Resource Wars, laser rifles saw military use alongside the Wattz 2000, a civilian-market rifle manufactured by Wattz Electronics with an extended barrel for greater range.
topic_desc_basic: The AER9 laser rifle is a pre-war U.S. military energy weapon powered by microfusion cells. It fires concentrated laser beams and is known for low recoil and long-range effectiveness.
tags: aer9 laser rifle,directed energy weapon,microfusion cell,pre-war military prototype,titanium crystal array,wave particle diverter

topic_desc: Before the Great War, REPCONN Aerospace and Poseidon Energy developed plasma rifle prototypes intended to supersede earlier models. The Winchester P94 design fires superheated plasma through a superconductor barrel, with a modified Turbo variant accelerating the bolt formation process. These weapons draw power from microfusion cells, the same energy source used by laser rifles. The Brotherhood Outcasts conducted extensive research on plasma weaponry at Fort Independence, analyzing the toroid plasma mechanism and barrel construction. Elder Lyons of the Capital Wasteland Brotherhood noted that while the knowledge to create humans remains, the manufacturing secrets for the P94 Plasma Rifle are largely lost, highlighting the rarity of this technology.
topic_desc_basic: Plasma rifles are rare pre-War energy weapons that fire bolts of superheated plasma capable of devastating organic targets. They are highly prized in the wasteland for their destructive power, though the knowledge required to manufacture them has been largely lost.
tags: molecular destabilization,plasma toroid,poseidon energy,repconn aerospace,superconductor barrel,winchester p94 plasma

topic_desc: The Gauss rifle utilizes electromagnetic coils to accelerate projectiles to hypersonic speeds, differing significantly from standard firearms and laser technology. The German M72 variant fires 2mm EC steel rounds, while a separate U.S. Army model was developed and deployed before the Great War. This American variant notably saw service during the Battle of Anchorage, where it was used by U.S. forces against Chinese invaders in Alaska. The weapon operates via magnetic induction rather than chemical propellants or gas excitation. The design family includes related weaponry such as the Gauss pistol, Gauss minigun, and Gauss shotgun, indicating a broad exploration of electromagnetic acceleration across multiple nations prior to the nuclear war.
topic_desc_basic: The Gauss rifle is a pre-War electromagnetic weapon that uses magnetic coils to fire projectiles at extreme velocities. A U.S. Army variant famously saw service during the Battle of Anchorage.
tags: 2mm ec rounds,battle of anchorage,electromagnetic projectile,german m72 gauss,magnetic induction weapon,pre-war military weapon

topic_desc: The Tesla Cannon was developed by the U.S. Government as a counterpart to Poseidon Energy's Solar Cannon, designed to function as a lightweight anti-tank weapon. Its mechanics are based on the pioneering work of Nikola Tesla and were featured in the publication *Future Weapons Today* for its compact design relative to its power. During the 2277 conflict in the Capital Wasteland, Brotherhood of Steel scribes successfully constructed their own Tesla Cannons. By integrating Tesla Coils, they created a weapon specifically effective against Enclave vertibird aircraft. This effort demonstrated the Brotherhood's ability to replicate advanced pre-War technology. Additionally, a miniaturized version of this technology powers ED-E, an Enclave eyebot prototype.
topic_desc_basic: The Tesla Cannon is a pre-War energy weapon designed as a lightweight anti-tank gun based on Nikola Tesla's designs. Brotherhood of Steel scribes in the Capital Wasteland later manufactured their own versions to combat Enclave vertibirds.
tags: anti-tank energy weapon,brotherhood enclave conflict,nikola tesla design,poseidon energy solar cannon,tesla cannon weapon,tesla coil

topic_desc: The Alien Blaster is a compact energy weapon of extraterrestrial origin, distinguished by destructive power far beyond what its small frame suggests. It fires concentrated energy bolts capable of inflicting catastrophic injuries. Its alien construction means replacement parts and ammunition are almost nonexistent in ordinary wasteland commerce, sharply limiting sustained use. Reports of the weapon are rare and usually associated with crashed craft, strange debris fields, or other evidence of extraterrestrial visitors. Specimens have been reported in both the Capital and Mojave wastelands, although many traders dismiss such stories as rumor. The weapon's scarcity gives it a near-mythical reputation among scavengers and collectors. People who have seen one fired generally agree that its unfamiliar technology is exceptionally lethal, even if they cannot explain its power source or manufacture.
topic_desc_basic: The Alien Blaster is a compact energy weapon of extraterrestrial origin that fires concentrated energy bolts with catastrophic force. It is incredibly rare, with reports usually linked to crashed alien craft in the Capital and Mojave wastelands. Its alien construction makes ammunition and parts almost impossible to find, giving it a near-mythical reputation among scavengers.
tags: alien energy weapon,capital wasteland weapon,compact energy pistol,extraterrestrial weapon,mojave wasteland weapon,rare alien technology

topic_desc: The Railway Rifle is an improvised pneumatic weapon that fires railway spikes at high velocity, with enough force to sever and pin limbs to surfaces. Constructed from scavenged components using specific schematics, it requires a crutch for the stock, a pressure cooker as a firing chamber, a steam gauge assembly for the forearm and barrel, and a fission battery for power. This design reflects the ingenuity of wasteland tinkerers repurposing pre-war industrial parts into armaments. The weapon's unconventional ammunition limits its widespread adoption, making it an uncommon sight in the Capital Wasteland. Its grisly capacity to pin targets to walls makes it a memorable tool in close-quarters engagements.
topic_desc_basic: The Railway Rifle is an uncommon improvised weapon in the Capital Wasteland that fires railway spikes at high velocity, reportedly with enough force to pin severed limbs to walls. Most wastelanders have only heard of it secondhand; few have ever seen one in use.
tags: capital wasteland firearm,craftable wasteland weapon,improvised pneumatic weapon,railway spike ammunition,scavenger built weapon

topic_desc: The Type 93 Chinese Assault Rifle is an automatic 5.56mm firearm built for military service before the Great War. Large wartime stockpiles have survived, allowing these rifles to circulate among Talon Company mercenaries, super mutants, Chinese remnant soldiers, and other armed groups throughout the Capital Wasteland. The weapon combines a sturdy military frame with a detachable magazine and remains effective despite two centuries of scavenging and repair. A notable customized example, the Xuanlong Assault Rifle, features a larger magazine and improved working parts. Records also refer to a Chinese Dragoon version connected with specialized troops. The continued demand for bulk shipments of Type 93 rifles indicates that settlements and armed organizations still value this dependable firepower.
topic_desc_basic: The Chinese Assault Rifle is a rugged automatic firearm chambered for 5.56mm ammunition. These rifles are common throughout the Capital Wasteland, carried by Talon Company mercenaries, super mutants, and various traders. A customized variant known as the Xuanlong is rumored to have a larger magazine. The rifle is valued for its dependable firepower.
tags: 5.56mm assault rifle,capital wasteland firearm,chinese automatic rifle,talon company weapon,type 93 rifle,xuanlong assault rifle

topic_desc: The Anti-Materiel Rifle is a bolt-action rifle designed for high-penetration, long-range engagements against hardened targets, vehicles, and fortified positions. Chambered for large-caliber ammunition, it delivers exceptional single-shot damage at the cost of a slow rate of fire dictated by its bolt-action mechanism. The rifle is valued by snipers, NCR marksmen, and independent operators across the Mojave Wasteland who require precision firepower capable of penetrating armor at extended distances. Its weight and ammunition scarcity make it a specialized tool rather than a general-purpose firearm. The weapon's presence in the Mojave reflects the region's militarized landscape, where entrenched factions and hardened targets necessitate anti-materiel capabilities.
topic_desc_basic: The Anti-Materiel Rifle is a heavy bolt-action rifle designed for long-range, high-penetration shots against armored targets. It is known among snipers and military marksmen in the Mojave Wasteland as a specialized weapon delivering exceptional single-shot damage. Its slow rate of fire and heavy ammunition make it uncommon among general wastelanders.
tags: anti materiel firearm,bolt action sniper rifle,high penetration rifle,long range marksman rifle,mojave wasteland weapon

topic_desc: The Service Rifle is the backbone of the New California Republic Army's infantry arsenal in the Mojave, issued to troopers deployed across the region. The weapon is pre-War in origin, reportedly a hybrid of older American military rifle platforms. It chambers 5.56mm rounds and feeds from a 20-round magazine, sharing iron sights with the lighter Assault Carbine. Its modular design accepts a forged receiver for increased durability and upgraded springs for a higher rate of fire. The rifle is common enough that NCR logistics depend on it heavily; troopers carry them as standard, and fallen soldiers' rifles litter battlefields across the Mojave. A unique variant known as the Survivalist's Rifle, chambered for 12.7mm rounds, was carried by a former U.S. soldier who survived in Zion Canyon.
topic_desc_basic: The Service Rifle is a semi-automatic 5.56mm rifle standard issue to NCR Army troopers throughout the Mojave Wasteland. It is widely seen carried by NCR soldiers and resembles a pre-War military design.
tags: 5.56mm semi-automatic,mojave military weapon,ncr standard rifle,pre-war rifle design,trooper sidearm

topic_desc: The Marksman Carbine is a precision semi-automatic rifle derived from pre-War paratrooper designs. It features an enhanced-zoom scope with a mil-dot reticle, similar to those found on heavy sniper rifles, allowing for effective engagement at extended ranges. While it shares the 5.56mm ammunition and magazine capacity of the standard Service Rifle, this platform offers superior accuracy and refinement. It is fielded in limited numbers by elite NCR forces, including rangers and Hoover Dam defenders, but has also been adopted by veteran Legionary assassins and various factions throughout the Mojave Wasteland.
topic_desc_basic: The Marksman Carbine is a scoped, semi-automatic rifle chambered for 5.56mm ammunition. Known for its high accuracy, it is commonly associated with elite NCR rangers and veterans, though it sees use among other experienced combatants in the Mojave.
tags: 5.56mm scoped rifle,hoover dam armament,marksman carbine rifle,ncr precision weapon,nellis air force base

topic_desc: The Survivalist's Rifle is a checkpoint carbine manufactured at Long Branch Arsenal in Ontario, then United States territory. Government property markings identify its 12.7mm chambering. The rifle later belonged to Randall Clark, a former American soldier who survived the Great War and lived alone in Zion Canyon for decades. It uses the familiar Service Rifle pattern but has been adapted for a much larger cartridge, a ten-round magazine, and the hard use expected by a solitary hunter and defender. The stock carries the hand-carved warnings STOP! and ARRÊT!, the latter reflecting Ontario's bilingual heritage. Its bent front sight and worn furniture show years of improvised repair rather than factory perfection. Clark kept the rifle close through his long watch over Zion, and its history makes it both a formidable firearm and a personal artifact of the man remembered by later inhabitants as the Father in the Cave.
topic_desc_basic: The Survivalist's Rifle is a heavily modified Service Rifle chambered for 12.7mm ammunition with a ten-round magazine. It bears United States government property markings and was manufactured at Long Branch Arsenal in Ontario. Its stock is carved with the words STOP! and ARRÊT! It is associated with the man known as the Father in the Cave in Zion Canyon.
tags: 12.7mm checkpoint carbine,long branch arsenal,randall clark rifle,survivalist firearm,zion canyon weapon

topic_desc: The Medicine Stick is a premium lever-action rifle based on the Brush Gun pattern and chambered for .45-70 Government ammunition. Its tubular magazine holds eight cartridges, each loaded by hand through a gate in the receiver. This arrangement lets a practiced shooter replace only the rounds already fired rather than exchanging an entire magazine. The heavy cartridge, long barrel, and solid action make the rifle suitable for hunting dangerous animals or confronting armored opponents at range. Its furniture and finish distinguish it from ordinary working rifles, presenting it as both a practical weapon and an expensive possession. The Gun Runners manufacture the weapon for well-funded buyers, demonstrating their ability to produce specialized arms rather than merely repair common salvage. Maintaining one requires access to .45-70 ammunition and knowledge of lever-action mechanisms, but in experienced hands it is a dependable Mojave long arm.
topic_desc_basic: The Medicine Stick is a finely crafted lever-action rifle chambered for .45-70 Government ammunition with an eight-round tubular magazine. Produced by the Gun Runners in the Mojave Wasteland, it is recognized as a premium long arm for wealthy clients seeking exceptional weaponry. It is based on the Brush Gun pattern and is loaded one cartridge at a time through a side gate.
tags: 45-70 lever action,gun runners arsenal,medicine stick rifle,premium mojave weapon,unique brush gun

topic_desc: Euclid's C-Finder is a portable targeting device connected to ARCHIMEDES II, the pre-War orbital laser platform controlled through HELIOS One. It calculates a target from the user's position and the satellite's orbit, allowing the platform to strike an outdoor location once its power and control systems are properly configured. Father Elijah searched for the device after it was scavenged and sold around New Vegas. It eventually reached a Freeside child named Max, who carries it as a toy without understanding its connection to the orbital weapon. The device's harmless appearance conceals one of the most destructive surviving components of the HELIOS One system.
topic_desc_basic: A Freeside boy named Max carries an unusual handheld rangefinder and treats it as a toy. Locals may recognize that it is more sophisticated than an ordinary child's possession, but few know where it came from or what it controls.
tags: archimedes ii weapon,euclidean targeting device,father elijah search,freeside children toy,helios one technology,orbital laser platform

topic_desc: The Platinum Chip was conceived by Robert House as a critical component in his plan to preserve and elevate New Vegas. Printed in Sunnyvale, California on October 22, 2077, the chip was intended to upgrade the Lucky 38 casino's computer systems and install the Mark II operating system on House's Securitron security robots. Had the chip arrived before the Great War on October 23, 2077, House's defensive systems would have intercepted all incoming nuclear warheads targeting the Las Vegas area; without it, some warheads still struck the region. The chip was lost in the chaos of the war and remained missing for over two centuries. House expended enormous resources searching for it, including 812,545 caps in a single year alone. The chip was eventually located by one of House's scavenger teams. To ensure safe transport, House had multiple delivery routes screened and dispatched the chip through the Mojave Express alongside five decoy packages of novelty items to obscure its importance. The chip's data is encoded on a surface resembling an oversized poker chip. Only two locations possess the computer hardware necessary to read the chip: the Lucky 38 casino and a weather monitoring station beneath Fortification Hill on The Fort, Caesar's Legion's main encampment. The chip's design bears the Lucky 38 logo, and it serves as both a data storage medium and a key to accessing the Securitron vault beneath The Fort.
tags: fortification hill bunker,lucky 38 upgrade,mojave express delivery,mr house data chip,securitron mark ii,sunnyvale pre-war manufacture

topic_desc: The Holorifle was designed and built by Father Elijah, the former elder of the Brotherhood of Steel's Mojave chapter, during his occupation of the Sierra Madre casino. Elijah fashioned the weapon using advanced technology acquired from the Big Empty, repurposing a standard grenade launcher frame modified with a hologram emitter derived from the Sierra Madre's security systems. Rather than firing conventional ammunition, the weapon projects a concentrated photon-based energy projectile, making it comparable to laser-based energy weapons despite its unique operating principle. The weapon draws power from Microfusion Cells loaded into a tubular under-barrel magazine. Its pump-action mechanism requires manual cycling. Elijah constructed the Holorifle partly to circumvent the Sierra Madre's security systems, which confiscate items bearing trace contamination. The weapon can accept modifications such as focus optics, advanced calibration, and reinforced components.
topic_desc_basic: The Holorifle is a unique energy weapon constructed by Father Elijah using technology from the Big Empty and the Sierra Madre. Built on a grenade launcher frame, it fires concentrated photon projectiles using Microfusion Cells. It is recognized for its ability to bypass the Sierra Madre's contamination sensors.
tags: big empty technology,father elijah weapon,microfusion cell ammunition,photon energy projectile,pump action energy weapon,sierra madre hologram technology

topic_desc: The Automatic Rifle is a heavy, fully automatic weapon chambered for .308 ammunition and fed by a twenty-round box magazine. Its construction derives from the pre-War M1918 Browning Automatic Rifle, with changes to the grip and other fittings made for later service. The long barrel and heavy cartridge give it the reach and force expected of a squad support weapon, while its automatic action can keep opponents pinned during an advance or retreat. Those advantages come with demanding handling. Recoil and muzzle movement make careful bursts more effective than uncontrolled fire, and sustained use wears the mechanism quickly unless it is cleaned and repaired. The rifle's considerable weight also makes it awkward for travelers carrying other supplies. Surviving examples are strongly associated with the Sierra Madre and its surrounding Villa, where old security stores and abandoned positions preserved weapons and ammunition behind the sealed resort's defenses.
topic_desc_basic: The Automatic Rifle is a heavy support weapon based on the pre-War M1918 Browning design. It fires .308 ammunition from a twenty-round box magazine and can deliver sustained automatic fire. Its weight, strong recoil, and need for frequent maintenance make it best suited to a prepared position or a physically capable operator.
tags: 308 caliber firearm,dead money support weapon,high spread automatic,m1918 automatic rifle,sierra madre weapon,villa police station

topic_desc: The Saturnite D-25A Fist was produced by the same company that manufactured Cosmic Knives, utilizing a distinctive ceramic alloy known as Saturnite. This material provides the weapon with its characteristic dark red and teal finish while reducing weight compared to standard Power Fists, allowing for more rapid successive blows. The weapon is found exclusively within the Big MT research crater, carried by Lobotomites and scattered in facilities such as the Saturnite Alloy Research Facility. A super-heated variant can be produced through the Sink's appliance infrastructure, applying extreme thermal energy to the Saturnite casing. The existence of a dedicated Saturnite Alloy Research Facility suggests Big MT conducted focused metallurgical study into this ceramic and its combat applications.
topic_desc_basic: The Saturnite D-25A Fist is a pre-War unarmed weapon manufactured from the same ceramic material as Cosmic Knives. It resembles a Power Fist but is lighter, trading raw impact for faster strikes. The product code "D-25A" and the Saturnite logo are stamped in white on its blackened red and teal frame. Examples have been recovered from Big MT facilities.
tags: big mt weapon,lobotomite equipment,old world blues,saturnite ceramic weapon,unarmed melee weapon

topic_desc: The Proton Axe is an Old World weapon developed within Big MT, distinguished by its electrified blue energy blade and dual capacitors. Its design channels protonic energy into close-quarters strikes, making it particularly devastating against robotic targets and individuals wearing powered armor, as the electrical discharge disrupts both circuitry and sealed systems. Cyberdogs are likewise vulnerable to its electrical effect. A stronger variant known as the Protonic Inversal Axe exists, along with thrown variants of both the standard and inversal models. The weapon is commonly recovered from Lobotomites roaming the Big MT crater and has been found in the Forbidden Zone dome. The Proton Axe's existence reflects Big MT's broader program of experimental energy weaponry.
topic_desc_basic: The Proton Axe is a pre-War melee weapon developed in Big MT, featuring an electrified blue energy blade. It channels protonic energy to disrupt robotic targets and powered armor. The weapon is often carried by Lobotomites within the crater and is part of the facility's experimental arsenal.
tags: anti robot weapon,big mt weapon,melee energy axe,old world blues,proton energy weapon

topic_desc: The Sonic Emitter is an experimental weapon platform developed at Big MT, the pre-War research installation known as the Big Empty. It functions by projecting concentrated sonic energy and can be reconfigured with distinct frequency modules, each altering the weapon's behavior and effectiveness against specific targets or obstacles. The weapon is tied to the Think Tank, a collective of pre-War scientists who replaced their bodies with machines and continue to operate within the crater. The Sonic Emitter exemplifies Big MT's approach to weaponizing unusual scientific principles, alongside projects that produced the Cazador, Nightstalker, and Robo-Scorpion. The crater's facilities, including the X-8 Research Center and X-13 Research Facility, house much of this technology.
topic_desc_basic: The Sonic Emitter is a weapon recovered from Big MT, developed as part of the crater's pre-War research programs. It projects focused sonic energy and can be modified with different frequency modules to alter its properties. The weapon is associated with the Think Tank's experimental technology and represents one of several unique armaments found within the Big Empty.
tags: big mt weapon,modular frequency weapon,old world blues,sonic energy weapon,think tank technology

topic_desc: Stimpaks were mass-produced before the Great War and became the standard pre-War medical intervention for trauma recovery. Their contents—a blend of healing agents, stimulants, antiseptic, blood compounds, and steel—accelerate the body's natural regenerative processes to a remarkable degree, frequently closing wounds almost instantly. The syringe features a content gauge and supports both intravenous and intramuscular administration. Professionally, stimpaks were used in conjunction with Auto-Docs and painkillers such as Med-X for postoperative care. The sheer volume of pre-War production ensured their survival into the post-apocalyptic era, and they remain among the most widely recognized and sought-after medical supplies in the wasteland. Research into improving stimpak formulations has continued post-War; a genetically bred strain of mutfruit known as strain 17 produces a unique sugar compound that stimulates platelet production and rapidly closes wounds. However, wild mutfruits absorb radiation and develop toxins that dilute the compound's effectiveness, meaning full utilization requires cultivation in a sterile laboratory environment. This limitation has prevented widespread adoption of the improved formula.
topic_desc_basic: A Stimpak is a handheld healing syringe filled with a mixture of healing agents, stimulants, antiseptic, blood, and steel. It boosts the body's natural regenerative functions, often producing near-instantaneous wound recovery. The syringe includes a gauge for checking its contents and can be administered intravenously or intramuscularly. Millions were produced before the Great War, making them a common sight across the wasteland.
tags: auto-doc supply,healing syringe,pre-war medicine,regenerative stimulant,wasteland medical item

topic_desc: Stimpaks represent one of the most significant pre-war medical advances, syringes containing a mixture of healing agents, stimulants, antiseptic, blood, and steel that boost the body's natural regenerative functions. In most cases, application leads to almost instantaneous regeneration of wounds. The syringe is equipped with a gauge for quickly identifying the state of the contents and can be used either intravenously or intramuscularly. Before the Great War, stimpaks were employed professionally through Auto-Docs in conjunction with Med-X and other painkillers for postoperative care and recovery.
