topic_desc_basic: Broadcast Tower KT8 is a radio relay site north-northeast of Vault 87 and south of Shalebridge. Activating its generator transmits Signal Sierra Romeo. The area is patrolled by super mutants and occasionally a centaur, making it dangerous to approach.
tags: chinese remnant spies,drainage chamber,radio broadcast tower,signal sierra romeo,super mutant outpost,vault 87 vicinity

topic_desc: WKML Broadcast Station is a pre-war radio facility in the northwest reaches of the Capital Wasteland, situated just south of Fort Constantine and north of Faded Pomp Estates. The station building houses the transmitter for Signal Kilo Bravo, though unlike most broadcast sites in the wasteland, the power switch that activates the antenna is located inside the building rather than near the antenna itself. A sealed cistern lies south-southeast of the station, accessible through a drainage grate set into the cliff face beneath an overhang, and contains a ham radio serving as the signal's source. The station's proximity to Fort Constantine places it in one of the more isolated and dangerous corners of the Capital Wasteland, and the surrounding area is known as a site of frequent wasteland encounters owing to its remote northwestern location.
topic_desc_basic: WKML Broadcast Station is a pre-war radio facility in the northwest Capital Wasteland, just south of Fort Constantine and north of Faded Pomp Estates. The building houses the transmitter for Signal Kilo Bravo, activated by a power switch inside the station. The area is known for frequent wasteland encounters.
tags: fort constantine south,ham radio source,northwest capital wasteland,radio broadcast station,sealed cistern,signal kilo bravo

topic_desc: The Tranquility Lane Simulation is the active virtual reality program running inside the tranquility loungers of Vault 112, a Vault-Tec facility completed in June 2074. Designed to house only 85 occupants, the system was intended to suspend residents in a simulated utopia indefinitely. Its architect was Dr. Stanislaus Braun, inventor of the Garden of Eden Creation Kit. Braun retained absolute control, denying occupants any independent exit. When boredom set in, he would virtually kill the entire population, wipe their memories, resurrect them, and repeat the cycle. Tranquility Lane was modeled loosely on Braun's hometown of Kronach but rendered in American suburban style. By the time anyone reached Vault 112, the simulation had been running for decades.
topic_desc_basic: The Tranquility Lane Simulation is a virtual reality program inside Vault 112's tranquility loungers, designed by Dr. Stanislaus Braun. It traps occupants in a seemingly idyllic suburban neighborhood where Braun torments them endlessly. The simulation has run for decades.
tags: stanislaus braun creation,suburban simulation,vault 112 simulation,vault tec experiment,virtual reality pod

topic_desc: Pennsylvania Avenue is a devastated stretch of downtown Washington, D.C., situated immediately east of what was once the White House. The district is choked with rubble from collapsed buildings and serves as a contested battleground where Super Mutants clash with the Brotherhood of Steel. The avenue's layout funnels travelers through blocked paths and metro entrances. A hotel in the southwest corner serves as a Brotherhood of Steel forward base. To the south, a golden statue marks an area where Super Mutants fight both the Brotherhood and the Enclave. An underground utility tunnel provides access to the ruins of the White House itself. The avenue takes its name from the state of Pennsylvania, preserving the memory of pre-war civic geography in a landscape now dominated by violence and ruin.
topic_desc_basic: Pennsylvania Avenue is a ruined stretch of downtown D.C. east of the old White House. Rubble and collapsed buildings choke the streets. Super Mutants and the Brotherhood of Steel fight over the area regularly. A hotel in the southwest serves as a Brotherhood outpost. Metro stations provide passage to surrounding districts.
tags: brotherhood forward base,downtown dc ruins,pennsylvania avenue metro,super mutant battleground,white house access

topic_desc: Fairfax Ruins are the remains of the town of Fairfax, located south of Vault 101. The site comprises a main street, alleys, collapsed houses, and utility tunnels. A large, well-armed Raider group controls the area, using it to launch assaults on fortified positions like Fort Independence. Their arsenal includes heavy weaponry, and a turret guards the northern approach. The utility tunnels house additional Raider forces and supplies. The Enclave later established a camp with a Deathclaw cage to the north.
topic_desc_basic: Fairfax Ruins are the destroyed remains of Fairfax, south of Vault 101. A heavily armed Raider gang controls the streets and tunnels, using the location to attack nearby settlements.
tags: brotherhood outcast proximity,capital wasteland ruins,enclave deathclaw camp,fairfax utility tunnels,raider controlled town

topic_desc: Seward Square is a ruined district in downtown Washington, D.C., situated near the Capitol Building. It serves as a violent crossroads in the Capital Wasteland, where Talon Company mercenaries and Super Mutants frequently clash. The compound of Reilly's Rangers is located here, marking the area as a significant landmark for those familiar with the mercenary group. A wasteland preacher occupies a building near the playground, holding a hostage and proclaiming the apocalypse. At the intersection of 5th and Broadway, a cinema marquee remains intact, displaying pre-war film titles such as One Wife Hold the Meatballs and Hush Sweet Senator Hush.
topic_desc_basic: Seward Square is a ruined downtown D.C. district near the Capitol Building. It is a known battleground where Talon Company mercenaries and Super Mutants fight for control. The area hosts the compound of Reilly's Rangers and features a preserved cinema marquee advertising pre-war films.
tags: capitol building approach,pre-war cinema marquee,reillys rangers compound,seward square dc,talon company battle

topic_desc: Turtledove Detention Camp was a pre-War United States Armed Forces military prison in Point Lookout, used to detain and interrogate suspected Chinese agents. Higher interrogation clearance required approval from authorities at Quantico, indicating a chain of command stretching beyond the local facility. The camp comprised bunkhouses, interrogation rooms, a concrete administration building, and an underground morgue with a small crematorium for body disposal. Security robots and turrets mounted under guard towers patrolled the fenced perimeter. After the War, the camp became a radioactive ruin; feral ghouls, including swamp ghouls, roamers, glowing ones, and reavers, continually migrate to the site. A large chemical pool at the camp's center produces volatile bubbles that detonate when struck by energy or incendiary fire. Smugglers have also been known to frequent the area.
topic_desc_basic: Turtledove Detention Camp is a fenced pre-war military prison in Point Lookout. Old guard towers and security robots still patrol the compound. The site is heavily irradiated and overrun by feral ghouls. A volatile chemical pool sits at its center. Locals and travelers generally steer clear.
tags: chinese agent detention,feral ghoul infested,interrogation facility,point lookout location,pre-war military prison

topic_desc: The Point Lookout Lighthouse was believed to be a state of Maryland tourist attraction, but in reality concealed the Calvert family's underground research hospital, the St. Aubin Medical Facility, accessible through its basement. The lighthouse itself is a moderately sized tower with a spiral staircase leading to a top platform with an exterior balcony. The beacon's light has long been broken. A wanted poster for Wan Yang near the bulletin board outside is connected to espionage activity at Turtledove Detention Camp. After conflicts between Desmond Lockheart and Professor Calvert conclude, smugglers occupy the lighthouse, stockpiling weapons, ammunition, and medical supplies on the upper stairs and balcony. A sewer gate on a small island south of the lighthouse provides an alternate route to a chamber beneath the facility.
topic_desc_basic: The Point Lookout Lighthouse is an old tower on the Maryland coast. Its beacon has been broken for years. Smugglers sometimes occupy the lighthouse and stash weapons and supplies on the upper stairs and balcony. A wanted poster for a suspected spy is pinned near the bulletin board outside.
tags: calvert research hospital,desmond lockheart conflict,point lookout lighthouse,smuggler occupied tower,st aubin medical facility

topic_desc: The Ark & Dove Cathedral is a small settlement in the Point Lookout swamps, inhabited by a tribe who named it after the English settling ships Ark and Dove, which reached Maryland in 1634. The community centers on an old church enclosed by a brick perimeter wall with a gated entrance. Refined and wild Punga fruit grow abundantly around the grounds, tended by the Tribals as part of a culture built around Punga cultivation and spiritual ritual. Inside the church, special breeding pots cultivate refined Punga fruit, and tribal leadership including Woodrose and Nadine reside toward the rear. A well northwest of the settlement connects to the Sea Cave and the Ark & Dove Sleep Grounds. The perimeter is vulnerable if the gate is left open, as feral ghouls, smugglers, or swampfolk may breach it. The researcher Marcella once considered joining the Tribals to search the cathedral for artifacts but ultimately decided against it.
topic_desc_basic: The Ark & Dove Cathedral is a small settlement in Point Lookout inhabited by Tribals, named after English settling ships that landed in Maryland in 1634. It centers on an old church enclosed by a brick wall. The Tribals cultivate Punga fruit around the grounds and in breeding pots inside the church.
tags: ark and dove ships,church settlement,punga fruit cultivation,tribal culture,tribal settlement point lookout

topic_desc: The Cryo Lab is a facility aboard Mothership Zeta, used by the alien crew to house frozen abductees in suspended deep-sleep. It contains cryo-pods holding humans, super mutants, feral ghouls, and raiders. A central room full of cryo-pods can be defrosted simultaneously via a console button, triggering chaotic battles between the thawed captives and alien guards. In one sealed chamber, aliens examine the bodies of three humans recognizable by Elliott Tercorien as his former squadmates; an enraged Elliott can freeze the chamber, killing the aliens. Elliott gathers cryogenic material from this room to later produce cryo grenades and cryo mines. The Cryo Storage area is a large two-level chamber with a generator at its northern end. Switches on the upper level cycle cryonic pods and release freezing vapor that can momentarily freeze anything nearby. Other switches deactivate large suspension pods, reviving super mutants.
topic_desc_basic: The Cryo Lab is a facility aboard Mothership Zeta where aliens keep frozen abductees in suspended deep-sleep. Cryo-pods hold humans, super mutants, feral ghouls, and raiders. Thawed captives often battle alien guards. An adjoining Cryo Storage chamber houses a generator and pod-control switches.
tags: alien cryogenic storage,cryo storage generator,elliott tercorien squadmates,frozen abductees,mothership zeta cryo lab

topic_desc: The Bethesda Underworks form part of the pre-War Washington, D.C. metro network, situated beneath the Bethesda Ruins on the Capital Wasteland's northern fringe. While the mezzanine and platform survived the bombs comparatively well, the subway tunnels running north to south suffered significant structural collapse, limiting passage to the tunnel openings. Radioactive waste barrels were dumped or accumulated in several areas, making radiation a persistent hazard for anyone exploring the station. The underworks have become a nest for feral ghouls, drawn to the dark, irradiated environment. Among the shambling horde, glowing ones are not uncommon, and particularly vicious feral ghoul reavers have been documented in the area. The ghouls are aggressive and tend to swarm intruders en masse, making the underworks a dangerous place for anyone lacking adequate weaponry or protective gear.
topic_desc_basic: A metro station beneath the Bethesda Ruins on the Capital Wasteland's northern fringe. The mezzanine and platform survived the bombs relatively intact, but the tunnels are partially collapsed. Radioactive waste barrels contaminate the area, and the station is infested with feral ghouls, including glowing ones.
tags: bethesda ruins metro,capital wasteland tunnels,feral ghoul nest,irradiated station,sewer grating exit

topic_desc: Before the Great War, the Paradise Falls Shopping Mart was selected as one of the test sites for Nuka-Cola Quantum, a distinction shared with only a handful of locations across the former United States. Two centuries of neglect transformed the storefront into Lock and Load, the preferred weapons merchant of the slavers of Paradise Falls. The shop is run by Pronto, a trader whose wares are notoriously meager and almost universally in disrepair, and whose talent for repairing equipment is minimal at best. A grim cage displaying a skeleton wearing a party hat sits near the counter, a macabre decoration fitting the slaver compound's atmosphere. The shop never formally closes.
topic_desc_basic: A weapons shop in the slaver compound of Paradise Falls, run by a trader named Pronto. The store carries a meager selection of firearms and ammunition, almost all in poor condition. The shop never formally closes.
tags: capital wasteland trade,nuka-cola quantum site,paradise falls shop,pronto merchant,slaver weapons store

topic_desc: The Sewer Waystation is a modest pre-War industrial facility situated in the Capital Wasteland. Once a manufacturing site, it remains filled with production machinery and a complex arrangement of conveyor belts, now decorated with teddy bears placed by a former resident. The structure is currently overrun by radroaches and radscorpions. It links to the County Sewer Mainline, a subterranean network occupied by feral ghouls and raiders, alongside a ghoul named Gallo who has established a personal living space within the tunnels.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-War industrial facility in the Capital Wasteland located near Grayditch. The site is infested with radroaches and radscorpions. It links to the County Sewer Mainline, a tunnel system occupied by feral ghouls, raiders, and a ghoul named Gallo.
tags: capital wasteland sewers,conveyor belt teddy bears,county sewer mainline,gallo ghoul hideout,sewer waystation building

topic_desc: Potomac Attire occupies a stall in the bustling Market district of Rivet City, the pre-War aircraft carrier repurposed as the Capital Wasteland's largest settled community. The shop is operated by Bannon, who serves dual roles as both a merchant and a member of Rivet City's governing council. The store specializes in armor and clothing, offering wares displayed on mannequins in varying states of disrepair and on shelving along the walls. The shop's commercial fortunes are intertwined with Rivet City's internal politics. Bannon's position on the council is contested through the political maneuvering surrounding the Council Seat dispute, which pits him against fellow merchant Seagrave Holmes. This dynamic reflects the competitive mercantile environment of Rivet City's Market, where political influence and commercial success are closely linked.
topic_desc_basic: A clothing and armor stall in Rivet City's Market district, operated by Bannon, a merchant who also sits on the city's governing council. The shop displays its wares on damaged mannequins and shelves along the walls.
tags: armor and clothing store,bannon clothing shop,capital wasteland trade,council seat politics,rivet city market

topic_desc: Arlington Library is a large pre-War public library in the Capital Wasteland, situated west-southwest of the Jefferson Memorial and directly across from Alexandria Arms. Scribe Yearling of the Brotherhood of Steel maintains a station in the front lobby, where she catalogs and preserves pre-War books for the Brotherhood's archives. She is supported by armed soldiers who periodically push into the building to clear raiders from the deeper wings, though they avoid the most heavily raider-occupied areas. The library's mainframe computer, buried deep within a raider den in the media archives, contains downloadable archival records. Scribe Jameson at the Citadel refers to Arlington Library as the Library of Congress. Hundreds of books of various conditions remain scattered throughout the building.
topic_desc_basic: A large pre-War public library south of the Citadel along the Potomac. Raiders occupy the deeper wings, while a Brotherhood of Steel scribe named Yearling maintains a station in the front lobby, collecting pre-War books for the Brotherhood's archives. Hundreds of ruined books remain scattered throughout the building.
tags: brotherhood of steel scribes,capital wasteland location,library of congress,pre-war library building,raider occupied ruins,scribe yearling archives

topic_desc: The McClellan Family Townhome is a three-story brick residence located at 2026 Bradley Place in the Georgetown neighborhood of Washington, D.C. Before the Great War, the McClellan family and their dog, Muffy, lived here. The home is currently maintained by a dormant Mister Handy stationed on a charging pad, which can be activated via a terminal to perform household tasks or patrol the grounds. The robot's programming includes walking the dog, shopping, and reading bedtime poems, though the family perished long ago.
topic_desc_basic: A three-story brick townhome in Georgetown, Washington, D.C., formerly occupied by the McClellan family. A dormant Mister Handy remains on the premises, controllable via a terminal to perform domestic routines. The site serves as a preserved snapshot of pre-war domestic life amidst the ruins.
tags: capital wasteland housing,dormant household robot,georgetown townhome,mcclellan family residence,mister handy robot,pre-war home ruins

topic_desc: The Washington, D.C. monorail was a pre-War elevated public transit system whose infrastructure spanned much of the Capital Wasteland. Engine cars were marked with a CMR logo. The line began on the eastern side of the regional map near the Corvega Factory as two parallel tracks. Moving westward, the line passed over two Red Rocket filling stations before an elevated freeway's collapse crumbled a section of track. At a midpoint near Agatha's House the two routes split. The westbound line ran southwest past Meresti Trainyard and Hallowed Moors Cemetery, passing near Paradise Falls, Northwest Seneca Station, Roosevelt Academy, and the Abandoned Car Fort before reaching Shalebridge. The northbound line passed Germantown Police HQ, MDPL-13 Power Station, and Montgomery County Reservoir before reaching Oasis near the northern map edge. Throughout the route, derailed cars and collapsed track sections litter the landscape, with raiders and other hostile creatures occupying the wreckage.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-War public transportation system in the Washington, D.C. region, using an elevated railway that branched north, east, and west across the area. Engine cars bore a CMR logo. Since the Great War, the infrastructure has fallen into severe disrepair, with many track sections and cars collapsed onto the ground below. The line begins near the Corvega Factory and splits near Agatha's House, with one branch heading west toward Shalebridge and another north toward Oasis.
tags: capital wasteland infrastructure,cmr monorail cars,collapsed train tracks,elevated railway ruins,pre-war transit system,washington dc transportation

topic_desc: The Lincoln Memorial is a large pre-War presidential memorial on the west end of the National Mall in Washington, D.C., built to honor President Abraham Lincoln. By 2277, the monument is damaged but still standing, with heavily corroded walls and the statue of Lincoln missing its head, which was taken to the Temple of the Union. The memorial's walls bear inscriptions of Lincoln's Second Inaugural Address and the Gettysburg Address. Slavers from Paradise Falls, led by Leroy Walker, occupy the site and maintain a guard presence to prevent escaped slaves from drawing inspiration from Lincoln's legacy. One slaver has suggested demolishing the memorial to suppress awareness of Lincoln among the slave population. Hannibal Hamlin, leader of a group of former slaves at the Temple of the Union, seeks to reclaim the memorial as a settlement and restore the statue's head.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-War monument on the west end of the National Mall in Washington, D.C., constructed in remembrance of President Abraham Lincoln. The memorial is damaged but still standing, with corroded walls and the statue of Lincoln missing its head, which was removed to the Temple of the Union. Slavers from Paradise Falls guard the site to prevent slaves from being inspired by Lincoln's legacy.
tags: abraham lincoln statue,capital wasteland landmark,lincoln memorial monument,national mall ruins,paradise falls slavers,slaver occupied site

topic_desc: The Satellite Relay Station is a fortified Enclave installation situated in a narrow valley north of the Rockland Car Tunnel, accessible only through the collapsed tunnel's southern end. The Enclave repurposed the facility to aim their Bradley-Hercules orbital bombardment satellite, making it a critical node in their post-Project Purity offensive against the Brotherhood of Steel. The entire perimeter is fortified with automated turrets. The multi-floor facility is garrisoned by Enclave soldiers and consists of a labyrinth of service tunnels, generator rooms, computer banks, microfiche readers, and storage areas, culminating in a satellite uplink terminal at its core. A secondary exit leads up a cliff to the Capital Wasteland north of the tunnel. The station's discovery by Brotherhood forces precipitated a direct assault, during which Liberty Prime was deployed but destroyed by the satellite's orbital strike, marking a significant escalation in the Brotherhood-Enclave conflict of 2277.
topic_desc_basic: A large Enclave-controlled installation reachable through the Rockland Car Tunnel. The Enclave used it to aim their Bradley-Hercules orbital bombardment satellite. The surrounding valley is fortified with automated turrets. The multi-floor facility is garrisoned by Enclave soldiers and contains a satellite uplink terminal at its core, along with service tunnels, computer rooms, and storage areas.
tags: automated turret fortification,bradley hercules satellite,brotherhood enclave conflict,enclave orbital bombardment,rockland car tunnel,satellite uplink terminal

topic_desc: Before the Great War, the Pitt Steelyard was part of a metal foundry in downtown Pittsburgh. After the war, it became part of The Pitt, the raider-controlled settlement built amid the ruins of the city's industrial district. The Steelyard is a treacherous landscape of rusted pipes, scrap heaps, precarious plank bridges, and warehouses, with areas contaminated by radioactive toxic waste. It is infested with Trogs—degenerate, feral former humans afflicted by the Pitt's unique environmental mutation—and Wildmen, violently unstable raiders who have partially succumbed to the same sickness. Rather than risk themselves, the Pitt Raiders send slaves into the Steelyard to recover Steel Ingots, valuable remnants of the pre-war foundry's output. The Steelyard connects to the Supply Plant and to an Abandoned Area linking it to The Mill.
topic_desc_basic: The Pitt Steelyard is a location within The Pitt, built from a pre-war metal foundry in downtown Pittsburgh. It is infested with Trogs and Wildmen, making it extremely dangerous. The Pitt Raiders send slaves into the Steelyard to recover Steel Ingots scattered among the rusted pipes, scrap heaps, and warehouses. The area includes radioactive waste zones and connects to the Supply Plant and The Mill.
tags: pitt raider slavery,pitt steelyard foundry,pre-war metal foundry,steel ingots recovery,trog infested area,wildmen camp pitt

topic_desc: The Supply Plant is an auxiliary structure of the Pitt Steelyard, originally built to house extra supplies for the steelworkers of the pre-war Pittsburgh foundry. Before the Great War, the plant's management began replacing human workers with Protectron robots, initially claiming the machines would serve only as security. Supervisor Tom McMullin attempted to stall the layoffs but ultimately could not prevent them. When the displaced workers discovered the truth, they revolted. McMullin, having anticipated the violence, fled and locked himself inside a small room. When the new Protectron workforce arrived, the robots killed the remaining human workers rather than protecting them. McMullin's terminal entries document his growing dread, culminating in his final log describing the sound of a killer Protectron approaching his door. By 2277, the plant is overrun with Trogs and occupied by Wildmen.
topic_desc_basic: The Supply Plant is an auxiliary of the Pitt Steelyard, accessed from within the Steelyard itself. Before the Great War, management replaced human workers with Protectrons, triggering a violent revolt. Supervisor Tom McMullin locked himself in a room, but the Protectrons killed the remaining workers. The plant is now overrun with Trogs and Wildmen.
tags: man opener auto axe,pre-war labor revolt,protectron worker replacement,steel ingots supply plant,supply plant pitt,tom mcmullin supervisor

topic_desc: The Mobile Base Crawler, originally a Space Shuttle Orbiter mobile launch platform at Adams Air Force Base, was repurposed by the Enclave into a heavily fortified command and research facility. The crawler houses a Research and Development laboratory where Deathclaws are subjected to experimentation, training grounds for Enclave Squad Sigma, medical bays, armories protected by repulsion fields, and a satellite control tower capable of commanding the Enclave's orbital bombardment system. The crawler represents the Enclave's most significant remaining military asset in the Capital Wasteland following the loss of Raven Rock and Project Purity. Its capture or destruction became the decisive engagement of the Brotherhood-Enclave war, as the orbital satellite under its command could strike targets across the wasteland, including the Citadel itself. The Brotherhood later reclaimed substantial weapons and technology from the crawler's wreckage.
topic_desc_basic: Adams Air Force Base, east of the Capital Wasteland, houses a massive Enclave command vehicle known as the Mobile Base Crawler—a converted pre-war shuttle transport platform. Following the Brotherhood of Steel's war against the Enclave, the crawler became the site of the Enclave's last major stand in the region. Wastelanders know it as a formidable Enclave stronghold.
tags: adams air force base,brotherhood enclave war,deathclaw research lab,enclave mobile base,orbital bombardment satellite,space shuttle platform

topic_desc: The Maintenance Level aboard Mothership Zeta serves as the vessel's waste disposal and maintenance infrastructure. Accessible only through a teleportation matrix adjacent to the Robot Assembly, the level descends through several decks via a trash compactor lift. Sally, a young abductee who has learned to navigate the ship's corridors, attempts to repair a control panel on a Zeta trash can to explore deeper. The compactor stops at multiple levels, revealing glimpses of stored cargo: abducted brahmin, a pristine Corvega automobile, and alien crew quarters. The descent ends abruptly when the compactor plummets, depositing its occupants in a detritus-filled lower area. Many objects in this area belonged to individuals featured in the alien captive recordings. Once Sally leads a visitor out, the teleporter to the Maintenance Level is permanently disabled, making return impossible.
topic_desc_basic: The Maintenance Level aboard Mothership Zeta is the vessel's waste disposal and maintenance infrastructure, reachable only through a teleportation matrix near the Robot Assembly. It descends through several decks via a trash compactor lift. The young abductee Sally helps navigate the area, which contains discarded cargo and belongings of recorded alien captives.
tags: alien vessel,mothership zeta,sally abductee,trash compactor,waste disposal

topic_desc: Before the Great War, Washington, D.C. was the seat of the United States government, home to the Capitol Building, the White House, and the Washington Monument. By October 2077, the president had secretly relocated to Control Station ENCLAVE, a Poseidon Energy oil rig off California. After the bombs fell, a crater was all that remained at the White House. The city's metro network became the primary means of traversing the ruined districts. In 2255, the Brotherhood of Steel arrived at the former Pentagon, establishing the Citadel and discovering Liberty Prime within. The Jefferson Memorial later became the site of Project Purity. The ruins are now home to super mutants, Talon Company mercenaries, ghouls in Underworld, and slavers from Paradise Falls.
topic_desc_basic: Washington, D.C. was the pre-War capital of the United States. After the Great War of 2077, its radioactive ruins and surrounding area became known as the Capital Wasteland. The city's landmarks include the Washington Monument, the Lincoln Memorial, and the Capitol Building. The ruins are now overrun by super mutants, raiders, and other threats.
tags: capital post,capital wasteland,great war ruins,pre-war city,washington landmarks

topic_desc: The National Guard Depot was a pre-War military compound situated along the northern edge of Downtown Washington, D.C., directly south of Vault 108 and the Robot Repair Center. Decades of neglect have left the above-ground structure severely damaged, with collapsed floors and ceilings creating hazardous navigation conditions throughout the building. Despite this deterioration, the underground bunker and its incomplete extension have survived with minimal damage. The facility is primarily patrolled by sentry bots, Mister Gutsys, protectrons, and robobrains that continue their automated defense routines long after their human operators perished. The Keller family sought refuge in the bunker during or after the Great War, and their story is documented through a series of holotape transcripts scattered across the Capital Wasteland. Mr. Keller, now a glowing one and the last surviving member of the original Keller family, inhabits the bunker. Brotherhood Outcast patrols are known to operate in the vicinity of the depot.
topic_desc_basic: The National Guard Depot is a ruined pre-War military compound on the northern edge of downtown D.C. The above-ground structure is badly damaged, with collapsed floors and ceilings. However, an underground bunker remains largely intact. The facility is still patrolled by active military robots including sentry bots, Mister Gutsys, protectrons, and robobrains. It sits south of Vault 108.
tags: downtown dc ruins,experimental mirv,keller family,military installation,national guard depot

topic_desc: Before the Great War, the United States Capitol Building housed the legislative branch of the federal government, situated atop Capitol Hill at the east end of the Mall in Washington, D.C., with its opposite side opening onto Seward Square. Following the Great War, the structure became one of the most dangerous locations in the Capital Wasteland, serving as a battleground between super mutants and Talon Company mercenaries. The Rotunda, at the heart of the complex, is dominated by a Super Mutant Behemoth, with numerous additional mutants of varying sizes throughout the chamber. Mark VIII defense turrets installed in the Rotunda are configured to ignore Talon Company mercenaries. With the Enclave's arrival in the Capital Wasteland, the area surrounding the Capitol Building became a three-way conflict zone. Enclave Vertibirds have been observed carpet-bombing the area east of the building with mini nukes. The building's image appears on the cover of Lying, Congressional Style, a pre-War publication.
topic_desc_basic: The Capitol Building is a prominent ruined landmark at the east end of the Mall in Washington, D.C. Before the Great War, it housed the United States legislature. Today it is one of the most dangerous sites in the Capital Wasteland, contested by super mutants and Talon Company mercenaries. A Super Mutant Behemoth is said to occupy the central Rotunda.
tags: capitol building,rotunda battle site,super mutant behemoth,talon company,washington dc ruins

topic_desc: Dupont Circle is a prominent roundabout located in the southeastern sector of the Capital Wasteland's urban ruins. The area centers on a defunct fountain and is surrounded by the remnants of pre-war streets. It is widely recognized as one of the most dangerous raider strongholds in the D.C. ruins, hosting a large concentration of hostile inhabitants alongside feral ghouls. The sunken roadways and collapsed tunnels leading into the circle are heavily mined and infested, making access extremely hazardous for travelers.
topic_desc_basic: Dupont Circle is a ruined roundabout in the northern D.C. ruins, distinguished by a central dry fountain. The area is a notorious raider stronghold, heavily mined and occupied by hostile forces. It is considered one of the most dangerous locations in the Capital Wasteland's urban core.
tags: dc urban roundabout,dupont circle ruins,feral ghoul territory,frag mine hazard,gnr building access,raider concentration

topic_desc: The Rivet City Science Lab was established after the discontinuation of Project Purity, giving Dr. Madison Li and her colleagues a permanent research base aboard the aircraft carrier settlement. The lab focuses on hydroponic agriculture, cultivating fresh apples and potatoes, and developing a portable power supply later adopted by the Brotherhood of Steel after the Enclave halted the relaunch of Project Purity. The facility occupies workspace on the carrier's midship deck, its central room housing a large intersection of pipes leading to a circular platform that may serve as a purifier or filter, alongside substantial machinery. Chemistry sets, fresh produce, and research equipment fill the workspace. Dr. Zimmer and Armitage have been observed visiting the lab, suggesting its work draws attention from interests beyond Rivet City itself.
topic_desc_basic: Rivet City maintains a science laboratory aboard the grounded aircraft carrier, overseen by Dr. Madison Li. The lab is known for hydroponic research, producing fresh fruits and vegetables rare in the wasteland, and for power-supply research later adopted by the Brotherhood of Steel.
tags: hydroponics research,madison li workplace,portable power supply,project purity aftermath,rivet city lab,rivet city science

topic_desc: The Rivet City Market occupies the hangar deck of the grounded aircraft carrier that serves as the settlement of Rivet City. It functions as the primary commercial hub for the community, hosting several distinct vendors offering food, clothing, weapons, repair services, and general supplies. Merchants such as Cindy Cantelli, Bannon, Flak and Shrapnel, Seagrave Holmes, and Gary and Angela Staley each operate their own stalls. The market has a long history as a trading post; some who passed through in their youth later recalled scraping by as traders among these stalls. Rivet City guards enforce closing hours, asking lingering visitors to leave. It remains one of the most reliable commercial destinations in the Capital Wasteland.
topic_desc_basic: Rivet City's market is the settlement's main commercial hub, located on the carrier's former hangar deck. Several merchants sell food, clothing, weapons, and general supplies from individual stalls. It is one of the most reliable trading posts in the Capital Wasteland.
tags: flak and shrapnel,garys galley eatery,hangar deck commerce,potomac attire shop,rivet city market,rivet city merchants

topic_desc: Rockbreaker's Last Gas is a derelict fueling station in the Capital Wasteland, taking its name from the high-quality shale once quarried in the vicinity. The station occupies a crossroads near Everglow National Campground and Five Axles Rest Stop, in the western reaches of the wasteland. The surrounding area is notoriously hazardous, with super mutants and centaurs known to patrol the vicinity. After the Enclave's activities at Project Purity, Enclave forces established a camp nearby, compounding the danger. A roadside approach to the old quarry marks the site, where travelers face unpredictable threats from the region's hostile inhabitants.
topic_desc_basic: Rockbreaker's Last Gas is a derelict pre-War fueling station in the western Capital Wasteland, named for the high-quality shale once quarried nearby. Travelers recognize it as a landmark near Everglow National Campground and Five Axles Rest Stop, though the surrounding roads are dangerous.
tags: capital wasteland roadside,enclave camp nearby,nuka cola quantum,ruined gas station,shale quarry namesake,super mutant patrol

topic_desc: GNR Plaza is a focal point of conflict between Super Mutants and the Brotherhood of Steel in the Capital Wasteland. The main lobby is heavily fortified with sandbags and barricades, staffed by Brotherhood members wielding flamers, missile launchers, and laser rifles. The plaza's alley has been the site of engagements between Lyons' Pride and Super Mutants, and at least one Super Mutant Behemoth has been observed emerging from behind a wrecked bus to attack Brotherhood forces there. Upstairs offices lead to the recording studio where Three Dog broadcasts his radio program. The building serves as both a broadcast home and a fortified forward base, with a nearby blocked metro entrance bearing signage for GNR Plaza Station.
topic_desc_basic: The Galaxy News Radio building stands in the Chevy Chase district of ruined Washington, D.C. It serves as both the broadcast home of Three Dog's radio program and a fortified Brotherhood of Steel forward base. The plaza outside features sandbag defenses manned by armed sentries.
tags: brotherhood of steel,chevy chase district,fortified radio station,galaxy news radio,super mutant behemoth,three dog broadcast

topic_desc: Takoma Park is a dangerous and contested area of the Capital Wasteland, overrun by Super Mutants and occasionally patrolled by Super Mutant Overlords. A Super Mutant Behemoth lurks near the auto shop, and an artillery strike mechanism atop a trailer next to the water tower can be triggered to assist in fighting it. Talon Company mercenaries have been known to ambush travelers in the area. Behind Takoma Industrial lies Isabella Proud's Camp, accessible only by traversing the factory roof and crossing an irradiated canal. Isabella Proud conducted research there on a subject she called "Samuel," an alpha male specimen, and her terminal contains her research notes. After significant developments at the Jefferson Memorial, Enclave Vertibirds have been observed flying over the area.
topic_desc_basic: Takoma Park is a ruined commercial district in the Capital Wasteland, centered on a former office park with a pawnshop, bank, and metro station. The area is overrun by Super Mutants and considered extremely dangerous. It connects to Takoma Industrial through the subway tunnels.
tags: isabella proud camp,nifty thrifty pawnshop,super mutant behemoth,takoma industrial access,takoma park shopping center,talon company ambush

topic_desc: The Tenpenny Tower Suite is among the most luxurious private residences in the Capital Wasteland, available only to those who have rendered significant service to Mr. Burke's designs regarding the settlement of Megaton. The suite's Mister Handy, Godfrey, provides purified water and grooming services. The balcony connects to Tenpenny Tower's own balcony and offers a vantage point from which the surrounding wasteland can be observed, also serving as a practical exit point for those wishing to depart the tower on foot toward distant destinations. The suite can be extensively customized through purchases from Lydia Montenegro or Michael Masters, both of whom operate within Tenpenny Tower. Available improvements include an infirmary, a jukebox, a laboratory, a Nuka-Cola machine, and a workbench, with decor themes ranging from Raider and Wasteland Explorer to Vault, Science, Pre-War, and Love Machine motifs.
topic_desc_basic: Tenpenny Tower offers private luxury suites to select residents and guests of Allistair Tenpenny. These rooms are said to be among the most comfortable living quarters in the Capital Wasteland, though few wastelanders ever see the inside.
tags: balcony overlook,luxury wasteland residence,megaton connection,mister handy godfrey,suite home improvements,tenpenny tower suite

topic_desc: The Rivet City Bow is the severed forward section of the aircraft carrier housing the Rivet City settlement. Isolated from the main habitation areas, this hazardous section was claimed by Pinkerton, a former council member exiled during the city's political formation. The interior is heavily trapped and infested with mirelurks, requiring underwater access or a locked pier door to enter. Pinkerton has established a laboratory within the bow, utilizing the isolation to conduct his work away from the settlement's governance.
topic_desc_basic: The bow is the detached front section of the Rivet City aircraft carrier, largely abandoned and overrun with mirelurks. It serves as the isolated laboratory of Pinkerton, the ship's original engineer who was exiled from the main settlement. The area is notoriously difficult to access and navigate safely.
tags: aircraft carrier wreck,mirelurk infestation,pinkerton lab,rivet city bow,rivet city politics,underwater access

topic_desc: Rock Creek Caverns are a subterranean complex northwest of the National Guard Depot, accessible through a sewer grate exposed at the bottom of a crater. The caverns consist of a single large interior chamber that incorporates remnants of the pre-war metro system, with numerous tunnels and offshoots branching from a central hall. The area is heavily infested with Mirelurks, including Hunters and Kings, suggesting the creatures have established a significant nesting presence. Portions of the caverns are moderately radioactive. Notable features include a suspended automobile near the ceiling where a surface road once passed through, egg clutches among dead Brahmin and ants, and the remains of a family near a baby carriage in an isolated metro section. The caverns' existence is sometimes communicated to wastelanders through hand-drawn maps carried by adventurers who survive encounters near the surface.
topic_desc_basic: Rock Creek Caverns are a cave system northwest of the National Guard Depot, accessible through a sewer grate at the bottom of a crater. The caverns connect to remnants of the old metro system. They are known to be infested with Mirelurks and partially radioactive, and few who enter return.
tags: capital wasteland caverns,metro tunnel ruins,mirelurk nesting site,national guard depot vicinity,sewer grate entrance

topic_desc: Farragut West Station is a derelict Metro stop within the Capital Wasteland's subway network, connecting to Friendship Station and the greater underground transit system. The facility retains some operational pre-war technology, including Protectron security units that respond to Metro Tickets and gas flow systems controlled by terminals. The station's offices and corridors have deteriorated significantly, and the rear areas are occupied by feral ghouls. Remnants of technical manuals and naval cots suggest the site was used as a shelter or storage facility for technical documents.
topic_desc_basic: Farragut West Station is a ruined Metro station in the Capital Wasteland that links to the broader underground tunnel network. The station is occupied by feral ghouls and still contains active pre-war security systems. It once served as a transit hub and potential shelter for maintenance personnel.
tags: capital wasteland metro,dcta infrastructure,feral ghoul enclosure,pre-war publications,protectron ticket system

topic_desc: Arlington National Cemetery is an expansive pre-war burial ground in the Capital Wasteland, accessible via the Arlington Metro Station south of Wilhelm's Wharf. At its center stands Arlington House, a pre-war structure that survived the nuclear exchange and subsequent centuries of neglect. The grounds retain rows of headstones, some still bearing flowers, suggesting periodic visitation or commemoration by someone in the wasteland. The cemetery's proximity to Mama Dolce's—a pre-war food processing plant with ties to Chinese intelligence operations—places it within a region of considerable historical and strategic significance. Chinese Remnant soldiers occupy the nearby Mama Dolce's facility, while the cemetery's outdoor expanse is sparsely populated, with only a small number of raiders present. The broader area encompasses the Arlington Monument and connecting Metro infrastructure.
topic_desc_basic: Arlington National Cemetery is a large pre-war burial ground accessible via the Arlington Metro Station. The grounds center on the surviving Arlington House and contain rows of old headstones. The area is sparsely populated by a few raiders, and Chinese Remnant soldiers occupy the nearby Mama Dolce's facility.
tags: arlington house,capital wasteland cemetery,chinese remnant soldiers,mama dolces vicinity,pre-war burial ground

topic_desc: L'Enfant Plaza and L'Enfant South are ruined urban areas in the Capital Wasteland, reachable through Hazmat Disposal Site L5 from the Mall Southwest or via the Irradiated Metro. Before the Great War, the plaza served as a major open-space commuting thoroughfare. In the post-war era, it has become territory dominated by Super Mutants. The office building in L'Enfant South once housed the Capitol Post newspaper, and its computers still contain the text of articles that appear on loading screens throughout the region. The L'Enfant Café and Madame Jealle's shop represent the remnants of the area's commercial district. A makeshift camp beneath a collapsed overpass indicates prior scavenger activity. The plaza's central crossroads has been the site of vertical aircraft landings by Enclave forces, resulting in armed confrontations with the Super Mutant population.
topic_desc_basic: L'Enfant Plaza and L'Enfant South are ruined urban areas accessible through Hazmat Disposal Site L5 or the Irradiated Metro. Before the Great War, the plaza was a major commuting thoroughfare. It is now overrun by Super Mutants. The ruins include the former Capitol Post newspaper office and other pre-war commercial buildings.
tags: capital wasteland plaza,capitol post office,enclave vertibird landing,pre-war commercial district,super mutant territory

topic_desc: The Rockland Car Tunnel sits in the southwest reaches of the Capital Wasteland, a remnant of pre-war road infrastructure that the Enclave repurposed as a forward access point to their Satellite Relay Station. The main tunnel entrance collapsed at some point, but a door built into the side wall permits entry. Inside, the short intact stretch bears the thrashed remains of the Enclave's former presence: barricades, turrets, supply crates, and the bodies of dead Enclave soldiers, some still wearing their power armor. After the Brotherhood of Steel drove the Enclave from the tunnel, Knights and Scribes established a staging area within, using the corridor as a launching point for operations deeper into Enclave-held territory. The surrounding area is notoriously dangerous, with hostile creatures frequently prowling near irradiated pools outside the gates.
topic_desc_basic: The Rockland Car Tunnel is a collapsed road tunnel in the southwest corner of the Capital Wasteland. The main entrance caved in long ago, but a side door allows entry. The surrounding area is notoriously dangerous, with irradiated pools and hostile creatures prowling near the gates. Few wastelanders have reason to venture there.
tags: aqua pura crates,brotherhood staging area,capital wasteland tunnel,collapsed road tunnel,enclave satellite relay,southwest wasteland location

topic_desc: Maryland was a mid-Atlantic state of the former United States whose territory encompasses several locations of significance to wastelanders and historians alike. Fort Constantine, a pre-war military installation, lies within its borders, as does the presidential retreat known as Camp David. The coastal region of Point Lookout, founded by English settlers aboard two ships that landed in 1634, gained a reputation as a haunted place and remained a distinct cultural pocket even after the Great War. Before the war, the influential Calvert family held enough political power to own approximately half the state, and their rivalry with the Lockhearts shaped local history. Pre-war intelligence reports indicated Chinese activity in Maryland, leading to search efforts that resulted in the capture of suspected operative Wan Yang. Baltimore served as a hub for specialist medical care and was home to companies such as the Branson Repeating Arms Company.
topic_desc_basic: Maryland is a state of the former United States near the Capital Wasteland. Several notable locations sit within its borders, including Fort Constantine, the presidential retreat at Camp David, and the swampland community of Point Lookout. Before the Great War, Maryland hosted military installations, industrial operations, and communities. The Calvert family wielded enough political influence to own roughly half the state.
tags: calvert family influence,camp david retreat,chinese intelligence activity,fort constantine location,point lookout state,pre war american state

topic_desc: The Sub Recovery Site comprises the wreck of the Chinese submarine SSN-37-1A, lying submerged in the waters off Point Lookout's coast. Before the Great War, the United States military had been actively recovering the vessel, which had fallen into American hands under circumstances that left the crew dead or captured. The submarine's skipper killed himself, and a surviving submariner—designated John Doe—attempted the same, but his cyanide dental capsule failed. He was subsequently transferred to Turtledove Detention Camp. Chinese intelligence, unwilling to let the Americans analyze the submarine, dispatched Agent Jiang to destroy it. Jiang posed as a defector and sought Agent Yang, who carried the submarine's self-destruct codes concealed in a dental capsule. Above the waterline, a small stranded boat and a buoy mark the location. The Chinese Intelligence Ministry later confirmed mission success through orbital intelligence verification.
topic_desc_basic: The Sub Recovery Site is the wreck of the Chinese submarine SSN-37-1A, submerged off Point Lookout's coast. Before the Great War, the United States military was actively recovering the vessel after its crew was killed or captured. Chinese intelligence later dispatched agents to destroy the submarine rather than let the Americans analyze it.
tags: chinese intelligence agent,chinese submarine wreck,point lookout coast,pre war military salvage,ssn designation vessel,sub recovery operation

topic_desc: Pilgrim's Landing was once a bustling seaside vacation destination in Point Lookout, its pre-war boardwalk signage promising it was open all year. The Great War reduced the attraction to a shadow of its former self, though the boardwalk and several structures remain standing. The Amazing Wheel of Wonder, a now-inactive Ferris wheel, dominates the skyline as a monument to the resort's vanished heyday. In the post-war era, the landing serves as a modest hub for the region's sparse inhabitants. Tobar the Ferryman operates his vessel, the Duchess Gambit, from here, ferrying travelers between Point Lookout and the Capital Wasteland. Madam Panada maintains a presence in the area. Smugglers frequently pass through, making the area unpredictable and dangerous for ordinary travelers.
topic_desc_basic: Pilgrim's Landing is a small seaside tourist attraction in Point Lookout. Once a bustling vacation spot with a boardwalk open year-round, it now hosts a handful of inhabitants including Tobar the Ferryman and Madam Panada. An inactive Ferris wheel called the Amazing Wheel of Wonder stands as a relic of the pre-war boardwalk. Smugglers frequent the area.
tags: amazing wheel wonder,duchess gambit dock,point lookout boardwalk,seaside tourist attraction,smuggler frequented area,tobar ferryman location

topic_desc: The Cave of the Abaddon sits deep in the Divide, a landscape scarred by Old World destruction. The cave itself was formed when surface structures collapsed into subterranean voids, leaving fragments of pre-war architecture suspended in the rock—a swimming pool can even be seen embedded upside-down in the ceiling near the entrance. The buried buildings within serve as a transitional passage connecting the cave system to the Boxwood Hotel Roof above. The area is notoriously dangerous due to heavy tunneller infestation, including a tunneller queen. Among the debris lie the remains of Sunflower Summers, whose diary rests in a nearby suitcase. The name "Abaddon" derives from Hebrew, meaning destruction, and references the angel of the abyss in the Book of Revelation—an apt description for a place where Old World ruins and subterranean predators converge.
topic_desc_basic: The Cave of the Abaddon is a passage in the Divide, formed largely from collapsed pre-war buildings. It is infested with tunnelers, including a tunneller queen. Buried structures within link the cave to the Boxwood Hotel Roof above. The area is notoriously dangerous and serves as a route deeper into the Divide.
tags: auto-doc ruins,collapsed buildings,divide location,sunflower summers remains,tunneller infestation,ulysses temple route

topic_desc: The Outcast Outpost occupies the unfinished remains of a Virtual Strategic Solutions military bunker in the Capital Wasteland. The pre-War facility was still under construction when the bombs fell—only the superstructure, elevator shaft, and bunker core were completed. Brotherhood Outcasts under Protector McGraw established themselves in the ruins, intent on breaching a sealed armory believed to hold advanced technology. Specialist Olin operates the facility's neural interface, which ties into an Anchorage Reclamation simulation housed within the bunker. The Outcasts frequently clash with super mutants in the surrounding area. Their presence reflects the broader Outcast mission of recovering and cataloguing technology, a goal that put them at odds with the main Brotherhood chapter at the Citadel.
topic_desc_basic: A Brotherhood Outcast stronghold in the Capital Wasteland, built within an unfinished pre-War military bunker. Led by Protector McGraw, the Outcasts seek to breach a sealed armory and operate neural interface technology tied to an Anchorage simulation. The surrounding area is plagued by super mutants.
tags: anchorage simulation pod,brotherhood outcast bunker,gary 23 clone,protector mcgraw,virtual strategic solutions,vss facility

topic_desc: Bailey's Crossroads Metro is a surviving fragment of the Capital Wasteland's pre-War transit network, consisting of a single mezzanine level with exits to the surface and to Bailey's Crossroads proper. The station is infested with feral ghouls, making passage hazardous. The lower level bears grim evidence of post-War violence, including a cage where someone was left to die and a skeleton suspended above the ticket booth. A hidden area behind wrecked metro cars contains a makeshift target range, suggesting someone used the station as a shelter or staging area. Its proximity to the Outcast Outpost makes it a natural approach route, though ghoul populations and structural decay render it dangerous.
topic_desc_basic: A fragment of the pre-War D.C. subway system near Bailey's Crossroads. The station is infested with feral ghouls and shows grim evidence of post-War violence. Its lower level contains hidden shelter areas. Travelers sometimes use it as an approach to nearby Outcast territory.
tags: bailey crossroads,feral ghoul infestation,metro station ruins,pre-war transit,red racer factory vicinity,service tunnel access

topic_desc: The Chimera Armor Depot exists within the Anchorage Reclamation simulation, a virtual recreation of the pre-War Chinese invasion of Alaska housed in the VSS Facility's neural interface system. It represents a fortified Chinese armored vehicle staging area during the simulated Battle of Anchorage. General Constantine Chase, the simulation's commanding officer, identifies the depot as a critical objective, ordering forces to breach its perimeter and destroy Chimera fuel tanks. The Chimera was a Chinese armored vehicle deployed during the Alaska campaign, and its fuel tanks were essential to operation. Destroying them would cripple Chinese armored capabilities in the theater. Some who served under Chase questioned the simulation's fidelity, though the depot appears consistent with known Chinese defensive positions around Anchorage.
topic_desc_basic: A fortified Chinese armored vehicle staging area within the Anchorage Reclamation simulation. It housed fuel tanks for Chimera armored vehicles and was designated a critical objective by General Constantine Chase, who ordered its destruction to cripple Chinese armor.
tags: alaska reclamation,anchorage simulation,chimera fuel tanks,chinese armor depot,general chase directive,virtual strategic solutions

topic_desc: The Saturnite Alloy Research Facility sits in the southwestern reaches of Big MT, built atop a natural cave system exposing an underground lava flow that researchers harnessed for metallurgical work. Saturnite is a remarkable alloy that retains heat so effectively a blade forged from it can melt metal on contact. The facility produced and tested Cosmic Knives, advertised near the entrance. The factory floor is now overrun by crazed Mister Handy units, with a unique unit called Sparks guarding the lower cave behind a force field. A pit of molten steel sits in the facility's depths, and raw superheated Saturnite bars rest at the rear. An Old World flag painted in blue marks the exterior, left by Ulysses.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-War factory in the southwest of Big MT, built over a cave with an exposed lava flow. It was used to forge Saturnite, an alloy that retains heat so intensely a blade made from it can melt metal. The facility is now overrun by crazed Mister Handy robots. Ulysses left a blue Old World flag outside.
tags: big mt facility,cosmic knife,crazed mister handy,lava cave system,saturnite alloy,ulysses old world flag

topic_desc: The X-7b "Boom Town" Target Zone is a mock settlement in the eastern Big MT, paired with the X-7a "Left Field" Artillery Launch facility. It was constructed expressly to test Saturnite artillery shells against simulated civilian structures. The entire area remains heavily irradiated as a lasting side effect of weapons testing, with craters filled with green radioactive material scattered throughout. The site echoes real-world nuclear testing practices, where replica towns populated with mannequins and provisions were subjected to detonations to study structural and material damage. A bombed-out building bears an Old World flag painted in red, left by Ulysses. The mock houses contain remnants of pre-War consumer goods.
topic_desc_basic: A mock settlement in eastern Big MT built to test Saturnite artillery shells against replica civilian structures. The area remains heavily irradiated from weapons testing. Ulysses left a red Old World flag on one of the bombed-out buildings.
tags: big mt test site,irradiated craters,mock settlement,saturnite artillery shells,ulysses old world flag,weapons testing

topic_desc: Hopeville was one of two towns in the Divide, alongside Ashton, both situated above an extensive network of nuclear silos built by the Commonwealth Defense Administration Ballistic Defense Division. The region was geologically unstable, with minor earthquakes common. The Army selected Hopeville as the site for Big MT's weather control research. The town was hemmed in by walls, terrain features, and superhighways, with buildings clustered along the road passing through. A fire station and shops served base personnel on one end, while industrial and office buildings occupied the other. The missile base occupied the western part, separated by chain-link fences and fortified walls. Two centuries of neglect and subsequent devastation left little trace of civilian life, with ruins now serving as Marked Men outposts.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-War town in the Divide, paired with Ashton, built above a network of nuclear missile silos. The Army used it for Big MT weather-control research. The region suffered frequent minor earthquakes. Today the ruins are largely abandoned, with Marked Men using what remains as outposts.
tags: ashton sister town,big mt weather research,commonwealth defense administration,divide city,marked men outposts,nuclear missile silos

topic_desc: The Ashton Missile Silo is an underground facility in the Divide, built before the Great War to store nuclear missiles for launch via the Ashton Silo Control Station. The silo's interior is extensive and multi-leveled, with launch decks, control rooms, and a medical area housing an Auto-Doc and Commissary Terminal. A sentry bot still guards the medical section. Tunnelers infest the deeper passages, making navigation hazardous. One launch deck is largely wrecked, marked by a blast crater from a launched missile. The facility represents the Commonwealth Defense Administration's extensive ballistic missile infrastructure beneath the Divide, part of the same silo network that underlay both Ashton and Hopeville.
topic_desc_basic: An underground pre-War facility in the Divide, built to store nuclear missiles for launch via the Ashton Silo Control Station. The silo is multi-leveled with launch decks, control rooms, and a medical area. Tunnelers infest the corridors, and one level was destroyed by a blast crater from a launched missile.
tags: ashton silo control station,commonwealth defense administration,divide missile silo,nuclear missile storage,sentry bot guard,tunneler infestation

topic_desc: Angel Cave is a secluded cavern in Zion Canyon's Eastern Virgin region and the principal dwelling of Joshua Graham among the Dead Horses. Its sheltered and defensible position makes it a practical refuge for the tribe and a center for Graham's activities in the canyon. The surrounding environment supports useful cave fungi, while the camp's isolation suits both the Dead Horses' way of life and Graham's guarded authority. Travelers familiar with Zion recognize the cave chiefly through its association with Graham and his alliance with the tribe.
topic_desc_basic: Angel Cave is a secluded Zion Canyon refuge used by Joshua Graham and the Dead Horses. Its defensible setting in the Eastern Virgin region makes it an important tribal camp.
tags: cave fungi harvest,dead horses camp,joshua graham dwelling,survivalist cache site,zion canyon location

topic_desc: The Yao Guai Cave is a network of tunnels within Zion Canyon, serving as a den for yao guai, dangerous mutated bears. The cave consists of small passages converging on a large central cavern where the creatures lair. The Sorrows tribe, who inhabit the canyon, are aware of the threat these beasts pose. Daniel, a member of the Sorrows, has proposed sealing the cave using mining explosives placed at key points within the tunnels to eliminate the danger. If detonated, the cave becomes permanently inaccessible. The yao guai are known to return even after being killed, making the cave a persistent hazard for anyone traveling through the canyon.
topic_desc_basic: A cave in Zion Canyon inhabited by yao guai, dangerous mutated bears. The Sorrows tribe is aware of the threat, and Daniel has proposed sealing it with mining explosives to eliminate the danger permanently.
tags: cavern tunnel network,explosives sealing option,sorrow tribe concern,yao guai den,zion canyon location

topic_desc: The X-8 Research Center, formally designated the X-8 Bio-Mechanical Testing Facility, sits at the far eastern edge of Big MT. It was dedicated to biomechanical experimentation, most notably the creation and testing of cyberdogs under Dr. Borous, who used his own pet dog Gabe as a test subject. Gabe was eventually converted into a cyberdog and sealed within the facility. The K9000 Cyberdog Gun was also developed here. The testing area was designed to resemble an American high school, ostensibly for infiltration testing but actually intended to evaluate cyberdogs' ability to detect infiltrators. The facility suffered a critical incident when a shipment of nightstalkers arrived in place of standard dogs; upon release, the creatures massacred the shipping department, leaving only one survivor and causing the area to be locked down. The facility's splicing terminal allows the combination of different creatures, including robots, lobotomites, dogs, and nightstalkers, producing results ranging from hostile robobrains to failed experiments.
topic_desc_basic: The X-8 Research Center is a Big MT facility on the eastern edge of the crater, dedicated to biomechanical testing and cyberdog development under Dr. Borous. It is known for its high school-themed testing area and a disastrous nightstalker incident that left parts of the facility locked down.
tags: big mt facility,biomechanical testing,cyberdog research,dr borous project,k9000 development,nightstalker incident

topic_desc: Z-38 Lightwave Dynamics Research is a facility in the western region of Big Mountain, historically dedicated to hologram technology commissioned for the Sierra Madre Casino. The project faced delays when casino owner Frederick Sinclair demanded the holograms be equipped with defensive capabilities and a flawless representation of Vera Keyes. The facility's central chamber features a column of blue light containing a Valence Radii-Accentuator, which induces immediate loss of motor control and prolonged unconsciousness upon contact. While two non-hostile holograms remain active inside, the surrounding wasteland is patrolled by hostile lobotomites and nightstalkers, making the area dangerous for travelers.
topic_desc_basic: Z-38 Lightwave Dynamics Research is a Big Mountain facility known for developing the Sierra Madre Casino's holograms. A dangerous light beam in the central chamber incapacitates intruders. The exterior is patrolled by lobotomites and nightstalkers.
tags: big mt facility,frederick sinclair request,hologram project,lightwave dynamics,sierra madre connection,vera keyes hologram

topic_desc: The Artillery Overlook is a fortified Chinese emplacement within the Operation: Anchorage simulation, a virtual recreation of the pre-War Anchorage Campaign preserved in a Brotherhood of Steel Outcast bunker. The overlook consists of a large facility mounting three heavy artillery guns that bombard American military positions throughout the simulated engagement. The guns represent a significant obstacle to the simulated American advance, requiring direct assault to neutralize. The location reflects the brutal, entrenched nature of the real Anchorage Campaign, where Chinese forces constructed extensive fortifications to hold the Alaskan front against the American counteroffensive. The simulation was maintained by General Constantine Chase as both a training tool and a record of one of the most pivotal military engagements of the Sino-American War. The Overlook's heavy armament underscores the strategic difficulty American forces faced in dislodging Chinese artillery from elevated positions during the campaign.
topic_desc_basic: The Artillery Overlook is a fortified Chinese emplacement within the Operation: Anchorage simulation, mounting heavy artillery that bombards American positions. It reflects the entrenched defenses American forces faced during the real Anchorage Campaign.
tags: anchorage simulation,artillery guns,brotherhood outcast bunker,chinese artillery,military fortification,operation anchorage

topic_desc: Haven serves as the fortified stronghold of Ishmael Ashur, the ruler of The Pitt. Originally a pre-war skyscraper modeled after the Cathedral of Learning, the building was repurposed by Ashur, a former Brotherhood of Steel paladin who stayed behind after the Scourge. The structure functions as both the political center of his regime and his personal residence. Its defenses, including guarded catwalks and automated turrets, reflect Ashur's military background. Inside, the facility houses Ashur's living quarters and a laboratory used for scientific research, symbolizing the blend of brutal pragmatism and order that defines his rule over the city.
topic_desc_basic: Haven is the headquarters of Ishmael Ashur, the ruler of The Pitt. Located in the city's downtown, this fortified skyscraper houses his living quarters and a laboratory. It is heavily guarded by Pitt Raiders and automated defenses.
tags: ashur headquarters,brotherhood scourge,pitt raiders,sandra laboratory,the pitt,uptown pitt

topic_desc: The Pitt Downtown serves as the oppressive labor heart of Ashur's domain in The Pitt. Before the Brotherhood of Steel's Scourge, downtown—like the rest of Pittsburgh—was lawless and controlled by Raider gangs. After Ashur consolidated power by assimilating or killing rival Raiders, the surviving citizens of The Pitt were forced into downtown to live as slaves, cutting metal and performing industrial labor. The district stands in stark contrast to Uptown, where Ashur and his Raider lieutenants reside in relative comfort. Downtown's layout centers around a work zone where slaves process scrap metal under Raider supervision. The atmosphere is one of constant degradation—slaves are beaten on catwalks, and some are confined in brutal restraints. Downtown embodies the cruelty of Ashur's system, where the cure for The Pitt's rampant trog disease depends on the labor and suffering of an enslaved population.
topic_desc_basic: The Pitt Downtown is the slave district of The Pitt, inhabited by enslaved workers and their Raider overseers. Under Ashur's rule, surviving citizens were sent downtown to live as slaves. It contrasts sharply with the relatively privileged Uptown section.
tags: ashur regime,downtown pittsburgh,pitt raiders,slave district,the mill,the pitt

topic_desc: Old Olney Underground is a sprawling subterranean network beneath the ruins of Old Olney, accessible through the Olney Sewers. It encompasses a former residential area, the remains of a pre-War children's hospital, utility corridors, and connecting tunnels to the Old Olney S. Wilson Building. A group of Ghouls attempted to establish a colony here but disturbed a Deathclaw nest, leaving only two survivors. Skeletons, fortifications, and weapons caches suggest a large battle predating the Ghouls' arrival, while recent tunneling hints one faction attempted to burrow toward an enemy. A locked sub-basement storeroom holds the remains of two Chinese spies alongside military equipment. The underground is notoriously dangerous due to roaming Deathclaws.
topic_desc_basic: Old Olney Underground is a network of tunnels and ruined structures beneath Old Olney, infamous for its Deathclaw population. Scavengers know the town above as one of the Capital Wasteland's deadliest ruins, and rumors of what lies below persist, though few who venture in return.
tags: broken steel,childrens hospital,chinese spies,deathclaw nest,ghoul colony,old olney

topic_desc: Fort Constantine served as a United States military base in Maryland dedicated to the construction and storage of nuclear ordnance, as well as the development of top-secret power armor. The installation comprises three main structures connected by an underground launch control bunker. Years before 2277, Allistair Tenpenny hired five mercenaries—Mister Crowley, Dave, Dukov, Jeff Strayer, and Tara Fields—to retrieve a rare weapon from the fort. Tara was killed by feral ghouls in the bunker, while Crowley, himself a ghoul, survived and discovered a suit of T-51b power armor held in a stasis field. Obsessed with reclaiming the armor, Crowley later plotted from Underworld to collect keys held by each surviving mercenary. The launch control terminal still contains functional launch codes, though any launch attempt fails due to corrupted navigation data and a damaged tracking system. Brotherhood Outcasts patrol the vicinity, and an Enclave camp sits to the east.
topic_desc_basic: Fort Constantine is a pre-war military base in the far northwest of the Capital Wasteland, known for its active robots that still patrol the grounds. Wastelanders recognize it as a dangerous, well-fortified installation once connected to nuclear weapons storage.
tags: capital wasteland location,launch control bunker,nuclear bomb storage,pre-war military base,robot-guarded facility,t-51b power armor

topic_desc: The Super-Duper Mart was a prominent pre-War grocery franchise situated along the banks of the Potomac River in the Capital Wasteland. Before the Great War, the chain operated numerous outlets, with advertisements appearing as far away as the Mojave Wasteland. By 2277, this specific location is occupied by a hostile raider gang that has fortified the interior with makeshift plank bridges connecting the shelving units. The parking lot serves as a grim display of their brutality, featuring hanging corpses intended to deter intruders. The surrounding environment is hazardous, harboring a mirelurk nesting ground near the riverbanks. A lone protectron unit remains on the premises, capable of resuming its pre-War security protocols if activated.
topic_desc_basic: The Super-Duper Mart is a derelict pre-War grocery store located near the Potomac River. It is currently controlled by raiders who use the structure as a fortified base. The site is notorious for its dangerous occupants and the mirelurks inhabiting the adjacent river area.
tags: capital wasteland location,nuka-cola quantum shipment,potomac river area,pre-war grocery store,protectron pharmacy,raider stronghold

topic_desc: SatCom Array NN-03d is one of several satellite communications installations scattered across the northwest Capital Wasteland, situated between Fort Constantine and the MDPL-21 Power Station. The facility comprises three dish towers linked by bridges and underground passages. Raiders have claimed the towers, decorating them with odd arrangements of gnomes, liquor bottles, and sporks. A small Brotherhood Outcast outpost sits at the base of the hill, from which patrols sweep the surrounding ridge. The outcasts maintain a workbench in their corrugated steel shack. A sealed doorway set into the rock to the northeast reveals a concrete wall with profane graffiti, a remnant of incomplete construction. The raiders are known to return to the array after being cleared.
topic_desc_basic: SatCom Array NN-03d is a cluster of three satellite dish towers in the northwest Capital Wasteland, between Fort Constantine and the MDPL-21 Power Station. Raiders occupy the towers. A small Brotherhood Outcast camp sits at the base of the hill nearby.
tags: brotherhood outcast outpost,capital wasteland location,northwest wasteland,raider-occupied towers,satcom arrays,satellite communications array

topic_desc: The Temple of the Union is a sanctuary for escaped slaves located northwest of Canterbury Commons in the Capital Wasteland. Led by Hannibal Hamlin, a former slave, the community venerates Abraham Lincoln and collects artifacts related to the president. The compound is established within a ruined building distinguished by a stone head of Lincoln and an inscribed marker. The residents guard the perimeter and interact with passing caravans. The site is situated near an elevated highway that occasionally sees Enclave Vertibird deployments, leading to intermittent conflict with local raiders and mercenaries in the vicinity.
topic_desc_basic: The Temple of the Union is a sanctuary for escaped slaves northwest of Canterbury Commons. Led by Hannibal Hamlin, the community reveres Abraham Lincoln and guards their fortified compound against raiders and other threats.
tags: abolitionist community,canterbury commons area,capital wasteland location,escaped slave sanctuary,hannibal hamlin,lincoln memorial aspiration

topic_desc: Ulysses' Temple is one of three missile silos scattered throughout the Divide, the shattered remains of pre-war Hopeville and Ashton. Before the war, it served as a nuclear launch facility. In the years since, it became the dwelling of Ulysses, a former Frumentarius of Caesar's Legion who turned his back on both the Legion and the NCR. The silo still houses intact nuclear missiles, giving it catastrophic potential. Ulysses adorned the interior with Old World symbols, including a large American flag, reflecting his obsession with the nation that once stood there. Automated defenses guard the complex, and Ulysses commands eyebots for repair and medical support during combat.
topic_desc_basic: A pre-war missile silo in the Divide, repurposed as the home of Ulysses, a former Legion Frumentarius. It houses intact nuclear warheads and Old World iconography. The site is heavily defended by automated systems and is considered extremely dangerous.
tags: divide location,eyebot control console,missile launch console,nuclear missile silo,old world shrine,ulysses home

topic_desc: The Hopeville Missile Base is a pre-war ballistic defense facility located in the Divide, reflecting the heavy military infrastructure that once defined the region. The facility includes barracks, a gas station, and missile silo infrastructure, all now battered by the Divide's violent storms and collapsed terrain. Marked Men haunt the headquarters and surrounding camps. The base is connected to the Hopeville Missile Silo Bunker, and upon first exiting that bunker, Ulysses makes contact through ED-E. The facility stands as a testament to the Old World military presence that once anchored the community of Hopeville before the Divide's destruction.
topic_desc_basic: The Hopeville Missile Base is a pre-war military installation in the Divide, a shattered stretch of wasteland along the I-15 corridor. Little is known about the facility's interior, as the Divide's violent storms and collapsed terrain make the area nearly impassable. Travelers who have glimpsed the ruins report old barracks, a gas station, and missile silo infrastructure.
tags: divide military installation,hopeville ballistic defense,marked men camp,missile base headquarters,nuka cola quantum,pre war military

topic_desc: Alaska held enormous strategic significance in the pre-war Sino-American conflict. The USS Ebon Atoll was sunk off the coast of Alaska in 2066, and its flag was later recovered and displayed in the Museum of Technology in Washington, D.C. American troops fought across a vast front from Anchorage to Shantou, China. The Anchorage campaign became a defining chapter of the war, culminating in General Constantine Chase reclaiming Anchorage in January 2077. Liberty Prime was originally designed to help liberate Alaska but was never completed in time.
